abstract: Many existing methods employ single-agent reinforcement learning （SARL） for individual robot or multi-agent reinforcement learning （MARL） for cooperative tasks in multi-robot systems. Unlike these approaches， to enhance the coordination control performance between an unmanned ground vehicle and its manipulator payload module， a vehicle-manipulator coordination control method based on MARL is proposed. Firstly， according to the structural characteristics of wheeled mobile robots， multiple agents are trained to control different components of the wheeled mobile manipulator. By maximizing global and local rewards simultaneously in a decoupled manner， the method enables the wheeled mobile manipulator to complete global tasks while improving the manipulator's manipulability. Secondly， the training simulation environment is constructed based on the Isaac Sim platform， and training is conducted for two different task scenarios. Finally， through designing a system deployment framework， the control policies obtained from simulation training are deployed from Isaac Sim to both the Gazebo environment and real vehicle environment. The simulation and experimental results show that the control method based on DE-MADDPG outperforms the baseline methods DDPG and MADDPG in terms of convergence speed， success rate， and manipulability， which can effectively optimize the manipulator configuration and enhance the vehicle-manipulator coordination control performance.

title: 基于自然驾驶数据的自动泊车系统测试评价方法
title_en: Test and Evaluation Method of Automatic Parking System Based on Natural Driving Data
name: Yang Xu,Wenli Li,Hao Xu,Xiaohui Shi
keywords: automatic parking,test and evaluation,objective evaluation,estimation of nuclear density,principal component analysis,XGBoost,SHAP,
abstract: To evaluate the automatic parking system more objectively and accurately， this paper proposes an objective evaluation method for the automatic parking system based on natural driving data. Firstly， parking data of human drivers in real scenarios are collected. The Kruskal-Wallis （K-W） non-parametric test method is adopted to screen out the significant difference indicators of different types of vehicles， and a correction factor is introduced to eliminate the statistical bias caused by model differences. Secondly， a Kernel Density Estimation （KDE） scoring model is constructed. Evaluation grade intervals are dynamically divided based on the distribution density of the indicators. To address the linear limitation of Principal Component Analysis （PCA） in weight allocation， an improved PCA strategy integrating the Extreme Gradient Boosting Tree algorithm （XGBoost） and the explainable framework （SHAP） is proposed. Through nonlinear modeling and contribution analysis， the weight allocation of the indicators is optimized. Finally， two cars equipped with the automatic parking system are selected for automatic parking tests. The proposed objective evaluation method is compared with the subjective evaluation method， and the effectiveness of the method is verified.

title: 基于DDMA-SAM的SLAM动态点语义滤除方法
title_en: Semantic Filtering of Dynamic Points for SLAM Based on DDMA-SAM
name: Xudong Zhang,Yingqun Liu,Ziyan Wu,Yuan Zou
keywords: semantic segmentation,dynamic point filtering,visual SLAM,deep learning,
abstract: The visual simultaneous localization and mapping （SLAM） algorithm in autonomous driving is a key technology for achieving environmental perception and autonomous positioning. Although existing methods attempt to detect and remove dynamic points through semantic segmentation， the segmentation models generally have complex structures and slow inference speeds， making them difficult to be deployed in resource-constrained environment. The DDMA-SAM semantic network proposed in this paper introduces decoupled distillation and multi-scale aggregation strategies， significantly reducing the model parameters while improving segmentation accuracy and filtering effect. The algorithm introduces a decoupled distillation mechanism to perform lightweight improvement on the segmentation all model （SAM）， constructing a DDMA-SAM semantic network composed of a multi-scale aggregation detection network and an efficient segmentation module， achieving high-precision and low-latency object segmentation. On this basis， a dual filtering strategy combining semantic priors and geometric constraints is designed to identify and remove dynamic feature points， retaining only static points for camera pose estimation， thereby enhancing the robustness and accuracy of the SLAM system. The comparative experiments on datasets show that the segmentation performance of the proposed algorithm is 1.2 percentage points higher in MIoU than the original SAM， with a 99.2% reduction in parameters. In dynamic scenes， the trajectory error is reduced by an average of 94.27%， 22.26%， and 28.94% compared to ORB-SLAM3， DynaSLAM， and DS-SLAM， respectively. The algorithm in this paper balances segmentation performance， computational efficiency， and positioning accuracy， suitable for autonomous driving application in resource-constrained environment.

title: 基于分层监督和多阶段迭代解码器的轨迹规划方法
title_en: A Multi-Stage Iterative Decoder with Hierarchical Supervision for Trajectory Planning
name: Chaoyi Chen,Nan Xu,Chong Guo,Liang Chu
keywords: motion planning,deep learning,hierarchical supervision,
abstract: Due to the uncertainty of the environment in which autonomous vehicles operate， accurate planning of the ego vehicle’s motion at every future moment is extremely difficult， and the concurrent consideration of global planning and local details is recognized as a key challenge. For this purpose， a deep learning model coupled with a hierarchical supervision strategy， named MHID， is proposed in this paper， which is based on multi-stage iterative query decoder. Firstly， by utilizing the navigation reference line as an anchor in combination with a recurrent attention mechanism， the long-term planning task is decomposed into a preliminary proposal for generating the global motion trend. Subsequently， in the refinement stage， a step-by-step iterative correction strategy is adopted， and precise guidance on trajectory increments at different time scales is provided through hierarchical supervision， so that local dynamic changes are effectively captured while the influence of distant uncertainty on overall planning accuracy is mitigated. The experimental results on the nuPlan dataset show that high safety and accuracy are achieved by MHID in both open-loop and closed-loop simulation.

title: 分体式飞行汽车氢-电混合动力能量管理策略
title_en: Energy Management Strategy for a Hydrogen-Electric Hybrid Power System in a Split-Type Flying Car
name: Jianhao Zhou,Xudong Zhao,Wanzhong Zhao,Chunyan Wang
keywords: split-type flying car,hydrogen-electric hybrid power system,nonlinear model predictive control,full-life-cycle optimized energy management,
abstract: The split-type flying car adds an aerial flight mode compared to traditional ground vehicles， leading to differences in energy demand， fluctuation characteristics， and component usage compared to ground modes， which complicates efficient energy flow control. To address this， this paper proposes a full-life-cycle optimized energy management strategy （EMS） based on nonlinear model predictive control （NMPC） with a multi-point shooting algorithm for a split-type series hybrid flying car. A hybrid power system model consisting of a battery pack， fuel cell pack， rotor motors， and ground vehicle drive motors is established. Subsequently， considering hydrogen consumption， impact of high and low load on fuel cell lifespan and the degradation of power battery lifespan， a full-life-cycle cost-optimal strategy is proposed. Finally， the full-life-cycle multi-point shooting MPC strategy is compared with rule-based， full-life-cycle dynamic programming （DP）， non-full-life-cycle DP， and MPC energy management strategies under integrated ground-air scenarios. The results validate the effectiveness and economic viability of the full-life-cycle optimized MS-MPC strategy.

title: 线控转向与电子差速转向系统协同控制研究
title_en: Research on Collaborative Control of Steering-by-Wire and Electronic Differential Steering System
name: Ping Xiao,Kai Jin,Aixi Yang,Limin Niu,Peicheng Shi,Xichang Zhao
keywords: battery electric vehicle,steering-by-wire,electronic differential steering system,collaborative control strategy,
abstract: To enhance the dynamic response and fault-tolerant capability of Type B electric vehicles during steering maneuvers， a new wire-controlled steering （steering-by-wire， SBW） and an electronic differential steering system （electronic differential steering system， EDSS） collaborative control strategy is proposed in this paper. A novel SBW-EDSS coupled dynamics model is established based on vehicles’ instability mechanism analysis. To optimize convergence speed and accuracy of the optimized algorithm， this study enhances the conventional Dung Beetle Optimizer （DBO） through introducing in regional contraction based Sinusoidal chaotic mapping， an improved golden sine algorithm， probability distribution， and optimal-value perturbation strategies. Based on this framework， a DBO-optimized Fractional-Order PID （DBO-FOPID） controller is designed for the steering motor. Furthermore， a collaborative control strategy is designed， with weight function employed to adjust the weight factors of the SBW and EDSS， to enhance the fault-tolerant capability of the steering system. Finally， steering test bench of chassis cooperative control is established to conduct SBW malfunction simulation under the double-lane-change working condition and low adhesion coefficient road. The simulation results demonstrate that the proposed controller achieves robust fault tolerance， rapid dynamic response， and minimal overshoot. Compared with present existing methods， the collaborative control strategy proposed in this paper enhances vehicles’ handling performance and safety more effectively.

title: 电子机械制动系统夹紧力非线性抗扰控制
title_en: Nonlinear Disturbance-Rejection Clamping Force Control for Electro-Mechanical Brake System
name: Jian Zhao,Ruijie Dang,Dali Jiang,Shuang Bai,Qixuan Wang,Yihan Zheng,Bing Zhu,Jiayi Han,Zhicheng Chen
keywords: vehicle engineering,electro-mechanical brake system,nonlinear disturbance,disturbance-rejection clamping force control,hardware-in-the-loop,
abstract: To address the complex nonlinear disturbance in Electro-Mechanical Brake （EMB） systems， such as frictional uncertainties and time-varying stiffness， a nonlinear disturbance-rejection clamping force control strategy based on super-twisting integral terminal sliding mode is proposed. Firstly， the Integral Terminal Sliding Mode Control （ITSMC） with finite-time convergence is applied to design a clamping force basic controller， ensuring excellent tracking performance for EMB in both transient and steady states. Based on this framework， the super-twisting algorithm is introduced to optimize the ITSMC， effectively mitigating control chattering. Then， an extended state observer is designed and embedded into the ITSMC， enabling the controller to maintain robustness against nonlinear disturbance in EMB with small control gains. Subsequently， the stability of the proposed controller is proven using Lyapunov theory， demonstrating that the control error converges within finite time. The hardware-in-the-loop experimental results show that compared with existing advanced clamping force control methods， the proposed control strategy significantly enhances the control performance of the EMB， achieving high accuracy， fast response， and strong robustness under various operating conditions.

title: 窄体倾斜车辆侧倾机构与稳定控制研究
title_en: Research on the Roll Mechanism and Stability Control of Narrow Tilting Vehicles
name: Shaobo Lu,Xuan Yue,Feng She
keywords: narrow tilting vehicles,tilting mechanism,steering-direct tilt control,moment distribution,hardware-in-the-loop,
abstract: For the problem of large driving force required for the active roll of the traditional narrow-track vehicle （NTV） chassis， this paper designs a rack and pinion type roll drive system based on the lever principle. Through the force-saving arm effect of the actuating arm， the driving torque demand of the system is significantly reduced. Meanwhile， this paper deeply analyzes the motion process of the steering roll control （STC） and establishes the STC dynamic model， revealing the mapping relationship between the front wheel angle， longitudinal vehicle speed and roll moment. Based on this model， this paper proposes a hierarchical control strategy for steering-direct roll control （SDTC）， with the upper layer using model predictive control （MPC） to calculate the required total roll moment and the lower layer dynamically allocating the roll moment components of STC and direct roll control （DTC） based on fuzzy rules. This paper builds a controller hardware-in-the-loop （HIL） test platform on ADAMS/Simulink and Raspberry Pi for verification. The results show that， compared with the DTC system， the proposed SDTC strategy reduces the maximum lateral load transfer rate of the vehicle by 53.66% and the maximum roll motor torque by 82.53% under high-speed conditions， indicating that this system can significantly improve the driving stability of the NTV during the steering roll process， reduce the driving torque demand of the actuator， and optimize the vehicle energy efficiency and driving performance.

title: 基于陀螺仪辅助加速度抑制与自适应步长的IMU动态坡度估计
title_en: IMU Dynamic Slope Estimation with Gyro-Aided Acceleration Suppression and Adaptive Step Size
name: Dafeng Song,Ronghui Xiang,Chaosheng Duan,Xiaohua Zeng
keywords: slope estimation,inertial measurement unit （IMU）,quaternion,adaptive step size,motion acceleration suppression,sensor fusion,
abstract: Accurate estimation of longitudinal and lateral road slope is significant for optimizing vehicle control and enhancing driving stability and economy. Low-cost Inertial Measurement Units （IMUs） are susceptible to motion acceleration interference during dynamic vehicle slope estimation， impacting the accuracy and robustness of crucial longitudinal and lateral slope information essential for vehicle control. For this problem， in this paper a dynamic longitudinal and lateral estimation algorithm based on quaternion gradient descent is proposed. Within the gradient descent fusion framework， this algorithm utilizes quaternions to achieve singularity-free 3D attitude determination， consequently enabling the integrated estimation of both longitudinal and lateral slope. To enhance performance， an adaptive step-size adjustment mechanism based on angular velocity is further integrated to optimize dynamic response， and a motion acceleration suppression strategy based on short-term gyroscope prediction is designed to mitigate non-gravitational acceleration interference. The real vehicle test results show that the algorithm effectively suppresses motion acceleration interference， and its dynamic response surpasses that of the fixed step-size method. Compared to the algorithm without suppression， the traditional Complementary Filter， and the Extended Kalman Filter （EKF） method， the proposed algorithm demonstrates significant advantages in overall accuracy （RMSE/MAE） and dynamic robustness for both longitudinal and lateral slope estimation. The study shows that this method provides an effective solution for achieving accurate， robust， and real-time longitudinal and lateral vehicle slope estimation using low-cost IMUs.

title: 基于LLC谐振变换器的多功能电池系统均衡器及其设计方法
title_en: A Multi-Functional Battery System Equalizer Based on LLC Resonant Converter and Its Design Method
name: Xudong Yang,Jijiao Yin,Rui Wang,Zeheng Chen,Yonggang Liu,Zheng Chen,Zhijian Liu
keywords: battery system,balancing control,lithium-ion battery,DC-DC converter,battery management system,
abstract: To address the issue of limited functionality for traditional equalizers， a multi-functional battery system equalizer based on LLC （inductor-inductor-capacitor） resonant converter is proposed. By utilizing two switch transistors， the proposed equalizer achieves battery pack energy balancing and has a controllable output while ensuring zero-voltage switching （ZVS） of the two transistors， with advantages such as enhanced functionality， compact circuit size， and lower switching loss. Firstly， the working principle of the proposed equalizer is analyzed. Then， its balancing performance is studied through simulation. Finally， to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed equalizer， its prototype is built and compared with other existing equalizers. The experiments， simulation， and comparison results show that the proposed equalizer provides a 6 V output voltage while effectively balancing the voltages of battery cells in the battery pack， reducing the maximum voltage difference to less than 0.1 V after balancing， thereby significantly improving circuit functionality.

title: 逆变器供电下的车用永磁同步电机噪声研究
title_en: Acoustic Noise Investigation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor for Electric Vehicles by Inverter
name: Fu Lin,Yihui Chen
keywords: permanent magnet synchronous motor,inverter,current harmonics,noise,operating deflecting shape,
abstract: A large number of high frequency current harmonics can be found in permanent magnet synchronous motor （PMSM） when driven by inverter， which induce serious high frequency noise. The frequency and sequence of current harmonics by inverter are firstly analyzed in this paper. The spatial and frequency orders of electromagnetic forces caused by current harmonics are derived. Then， a finite element model （FEM） with high frequency current harmonics into consideration is built. Both radial force and torque ripple are calculated to validate the influence of current harmonics on electromagnetic force. Finally， the noise test is conducted to verify the noise orders induced by current harmonics and the variation laws of current harmonics and noise in a wide speed range are analyzed. And the vibration modes at the noise peak are analyzed through the deformation tests， pointing out the contribution of radial force and torque ripple. The results show that the electromagnetic forces induced by high frequency current harmonics not only produce radial vibration with the 0th and 2pth spatial order （p is the number of pole pairs）， but also excite the tangential vibration of stator. Additionally， the sideband noise centered around the switching frequency and its harmonics， which close to the stator mode exhibits over 10 dB（A） higher than that far from the stator mode.

title: 基于温度特征的车用PMSM匝间短路故障诊断方法研究
title_en: Research on Turn-to-Turn Short Circuit Fault Diagnosis Method for Vehicle PMSM Based on Temperature Characteristics
name: Dean Meng,Mulin Cheng,Dianxiang Guo,Jianping Wang,Xuan Zhao
keywords: PMSM,fault diagnosis,temperature field,neural network,integrated learning,
abstract: Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors （PMSM） used in vehicles are prone to inter-turn short circuits under harsh operating conditions， which compromises vehicle operational safety. Accurate identification of inter-turn short-circuit faults is crucial for preventing motor degradation and formulating fault-tolerant control strategies. This paper reveals the characteristic patterns exhibited by PMSM under inter-turn short-circuit faults and proposes a fault diagnosis method based on low-sampling-frequency motor temperature data. Specifically， a mathematical model of the PMSM and a numerical simulation model for inter-turn short circuits are established to investigate the variation patterns of parameters such as current and air-gap magnetic density， while calculating stator/rotor core loss and winding copper loss. Using Fluent software， the temperature fields of motors under varying degrees of fault severity are simulated. Temperature data from measurement points is extracted to calculate fault characteristic values. A BP-Adaboost neural network is then designed to develop a temperature-feature-based fault diagnosis model. The model is ultimately validated through a fault test platform， achieving a diagnostic accuracy of 97.96%， demonstrating its effectiveness.

title: 基于动态集成模型的汽车前端结构优化设计
title_en: Optimized Design of Automotive Front-End Structure Based on Dynamic Integration Modeling
name: Yong Chen,Qihui Lin,Shaowei Chen,Tao Chen,Aiguo Cheng
keywords: automotive front-end structure,multi-objective optimization,ensemble model,multi-objective coati optimization algorithm,crashworthiness,
abstract: For the problems of low fitting accuracy in surrogate models and suboptimal performance in multi-objective optimization for automotive front-end structure design， an optimization approach based on a dynamic ensemble model and a novel multi-objective coati optimization algorithm is proposed in this paper. Firstly， a parameterized model of the automotive front-end structure is established， defining structural performance metrics and design variables， with data obtained through finite element simulation analysis. Next， a dynamic ensemble model is constructed based on an adaptive filtering mechanism and a multidimensional weighted combination strategy. Subsequently， a high-accuracy surrogate model is developed based on simulation data to map the relationship between structural performance and design variables. Finally， a novel multi-objective coati optimization algorithm is introduced by reconstructing population initialization strategies， optimization processes， and update mechanism， enabling multi-objective optimization of the front-end structure. The optimization results show that the optimized structure significantly outperforms the baseline model， with an average improvement rate exceeding 10% across all performance metrics. The proposed method effectively enhances the crashworthiness of automotive front-end structures and provides a theoretical foundation for intelligent design and optimization in the field of automotive structural engineering.

title: 基于刚度理论的车辆兼容性指标计算方法研究
title_en: Methodological Study on Vehicle Compatibility Assessment Based on Structural Stiffness Analysis
name: Shiwen Huang,Xiuquan Xu,Fan Zhang,Haitao Zhu
keywords: vehicle compatibility assessment,MPDB,simplified method,OLC,
abstract: This paper aims to establish a rapid assessment method for calculating the compatibility index OLC of MPDB tests based on vehicle frontal impact test data. The research constructs a theoretical analysis framework of vehicle impact energy conservation， momentum conservation and a simplified spring model. Firstly， the displacement-stiffness curve of the vehicle front structure is calculated through the x-direction acceleration sensor data in the FWRB test. Then， based on the equivalent stiffness principle， the maximum acceleration and maximum displacement of the three types of tests， FWRB/ODB/MPDB， are calculated， and the calculation method is verified by real vehicle impact test data. Finally， an innovative method for estimating the MPDB test compatibility index OLC combining FWRB test data with the dynamic response of the simplified spring model is proposed. The results show that the estimated results of this method are highly consistent with the measured values of the test （error < 10%）， providing an efficient and reliable engineering solution for the calculation of impact compatibility in the vehicle development stage.

title: 汽车车身挤压铝门槛梁耐撞性多目标优化设计
title_en: Crashworthiness of Extruded Aluminum Threshold Beams for Automotive Bodies Multi-Objective Optimization Design
name: Pengcheng Xu,Kewei Li,Peijie Xiao,Ning Zhang,Qi Ma,Zhi Xiao,Shiwei Xu
keywords: extruded aluminum sill beam,linear topology optimization,nonlinear topology optimization,deformation-mode refinement,multi-objective optimization,
abstract: For the challenge of the coordinated design of the crashworthiness and lightweight of the threshold beam in the side pole impact condition of new energy vehicles， this paper proposes a multi-objective optimization design method for structural crashworthiness based on the dynamic nonlinear topology theory framework. Firstly， an equivalent simplified model of the side pole impact condition of the vehicle sub-system is constructed. Secondly， two topology optimization methods， linear and nonlinear， are adopted to establish a multi-objective optimization system considering the extrusion thickness constraint based on the surrogate model， and the advantages of the nonlinear method in the large deformation crashworthiness characteristics are compared and analyzed. Finally， a rapid correction strategy guided by the deformation mode is proposed， and the rapid correction design of global topology optimization and local performance enhancement is achieved through the strengthening of the weak zone characteristics. This method combines the deformation mode correction and the parameterized experimental design （DOE） optimization to further improve the crashworthiness of the threshold beam structure， so as to provide a new solution for the design of ultra-light extruded aluminum threshold beams.

title: 轻量化多材料连接中自冲铆接复合工艺研究进展
title_en: Research Progress on Self-Piercing Riveting Composite Process in Lightweight Multi-Material Connection
name: Zhiqiang Cai,Jianyu Li,Shiwei Xu,Peijie Xiao,Hao Li,Chong Lin,Shilong Li,Minjiao Zhang
keywords: self-piercing riveting,composite process,joint quality,mechanical properties,fatigue life,
abstract: The self-piercing riveting， as an important cold jointing technology， is suitable for the connection of a variety of materials， and its process is environmentally friendly， simple and efficient operation， and has high dynamic and static strength， so it is widely used in lightweight material connection. In order to further improve the connection quality and optimize the structural performance， the composite process formed by the combination of self-piercing riveting and other processes has become a research hotspot， and the composite process has successfully overcome the cracking problem of self-piercing riveting when connecting low-ductility materials， as well as the upsetting problem encountered when connecting high-strength materials of rivets， which has achieved great improvement in connection effect. In this paper， the research progress of self-piercing riveting composite process is reviewed， focusing on friction self-piercing riveting， self-piercing adhesive riveting， electromagnetic self-piercing riveting， thermal self-piercing riveting and other composite process. By analyzing the technological process， advantages and disadvantages of each process and the influencing factors of joint quality， the development trend and application prospect of self-piercing riveting composite process are discussed. It provides a scientific basis for decision-making of lightweight connection technology route of the body.

title: 柴油/四氢呋喃混合燃料喷雾特性及其结构不稳定性的研究
title_en: Study on Spray Characteristics and Structure Instability of Diesel/Tetrahydrofuran Blended Fuel
name: Yanlei Ma,Fengyu Sun,Hao Chen,Peng Zhang,Zhenhua Ji,Ziye Zhang
keywords: tetrahydrofuran,spray characteristics,spray structure instability,proper orthogonal decomposition,
abstract: Tetrahydrofuran （THF） is a highly oxygenated， widely sourced and promising carbon-neutral alternative fuel. In this study the effect of different ambient temperature （300，673 K）， background pressure （3，4 MPa）， and THF blending ratio （10%，20%，30%，40%） on the macroscopic spray characteristics of diesel/THF blended fuel is investigated in a constant volume combustion chamber， and the proper orthogonal decomposition （POD） is employed to reveal the effect of different ambient temperature， background pressures and THF blending ratio on the spray structure instability. The results indicate that the addition of THF significantly improves the atomization and evaporation characteristics of the diesel/THF blended fuel， resulting in shorter spray tip penetration （STP） and larger spray cone angle （SCA） for the diesel/THF blended fuel. Furthermore， the effect of fuel properties on spray characteristics is significantly enhanced at low background pressure and high ambient temperature. The favorable evaporation characteristics of THF further accentuate the advantages presented by low background pressure and high ambient temperature. However， the effect of ambient conditions on spray characteristics is significantly more pronounced， in comparison to the effect of fuel properties on spray characteristics. In addition， the spray structure instability of diesel/THF blended fuel increases with the increase in the proportion of THF added. The effect of background pressure and ambient temperature on spray structure instability is not a single dominant mechanism， but a coupling of the two.

title: RDE排放对激进驾驶响应差异性的研究
title_en: Different Response of RDE Emission to Aggressive Driving
name: Yachao Wang,Hang Yin,Shijin Shuai,Yunshan Ge
keywords: aggressive driving,real driving emission,CO<sub>2</sub> emission,exhaust pollutants,
abstract: To assess the different response of RDE emission to aggressive driving， one hybrid vehicle and one fuel vehicle are tested under original road spectrum conditions and acceleration-scalled road spectrum conditions， and the PEMS is used to measure the CO2， CO， NO xand PN emission. The results show that aggressive driving increases the CO2 emission and CO emission factors for two vehicles； and for NO x and PN emission， emission increases with aggressive driving for the fuel vehicle while no increase in emission for the hybrid vehicle. The differences in NO x and PN emission characteristics between two vehicles are mainly caused by the distinct responses of their powertrains to aggressive driving and the resulting variations in the state of after-treatment systems. These findings demonstrate that vehicle RDE emission respond differently to aggressive driving.

title: 重型商用车预见性自适应巡航控制策略研究
title_en: Research on Control Strategy of Predictive Adaptive Cruise Control of Heavy Duty Commercial Vehicle
name: Xingkun Li,Xuguang Zheng,Guohui Wang,Yuhai Wang
keywords: predictive adaptive cruise,gradient of the road,economic speed,adaptive inter-vehicle distance,
abstract: In order to improve the economy and safety of commercial vehicle cruise system， a predictive adaptive cruise control system （PACC） is designed considering fuel saving and safe driving， and the economic speed of the predictive cruise is planned based on the road slope ahead. An optimized predictive adaptive cruise control strategy based on the front vehicle information is proposed to solve the problem of braking disturbance caused by the vehicle in front during cruise. Based on the gradient of the road ahead， the adaptive inter-vehicle distance is designed and the driving speed of the main vehicle is planned to realize the predictive adaptive cruising. A real vehicle test is carried out based on FAW JH6 heavy-duty commercial vehicle. The research results show that the algorithm can effectively reduce fuel consumption and driving fatigue， which provides extremely important theoretical and practical value for the development of commercial vehicle driving assistance system.

title: 考虑路径平滑性和避撞稳定性的智能汽车弯道轨迹规划研究
title_en: Research on Cornering Trajectory Planning for Intelligent Vehicle Considering Trajectory Smoothness and Stability for Collision Avoidance
name: Jiaxing Yu,Arab Aliasghar,Xiaofei Pei,Xuexun Guo
keywords: intelligent vehicle,trajectory planning,rapidly exploring random tree,speed planning,cornering collision avoidance,
abstract: A trajectory planning is proposed for collision avoidance in a corner of intelligent vehicle considering trajectory smoothness and vehicle stability. The trajectory planning is decomposed into path planning and speed planning. The improved rapidly exploring random tree （RRT） is used to construct a collision-free continuous-curvature clothoids with minimum curvature change. Based on the measurement function of deep neural network， the improved RRT selects and connects the tree nodes with the smallest cost function， and searches the nearby nodes to find whether there are nodes with smaller cost function near the selected nodes. In speed planning， trapezoidal velocity profiles are used to output continuous target acceleration curve according to the road speed limit rules. Then， based on the curvature of clothoids and vehicle state， the target acceleration is dynamically adjusted by Preview G-Vectoring control （PGVC）. Finally， the final expected acceleration is obtained through acceleration control logic. The simulation results show that the proposed trajectory planning method can not only achieve collision avoidance in a corner and guarantee a good tracking performance， but also improve the stability in a corner at high speed. Besides， the paper also verifies the fast convergence， path smoothness and real-time performance based on parallel computing of RRT.

title: 复杂路况下无人驾驶路径跟踪模型预测控制研究
title_en: Research on Model Predictive Control of Autonomous Vehicle Path Tracking Under Complex Road Condition
name: Jun Li,Wenxing Wan,Sanqiang Hao,Wu Qin,Feifei Liu
keywords: autonomous vehicle,path tracking,model predictive control,complex road condition,
abstract: To improve the path tracking accuracy， driving stability and safety of autonomous vehicle under complex road conditions of right angle turn， continuous curve and arc curve， an improved model predictive control （MPC） algorithm is proposed. The salient feature of the improved MPC is that the maximum longitudinal speed of vehicle without sliding on the flat road is determined by the curvature of the travel path， that is， the longitudinal speed of the vehicle is not assumed to be constant. Based on model predictive control， the vehicle kinematics model is established. Speed and front wheel angle are set as constraints. And position deviation and control increment are designed as the objective function to obtain the optimal front wheel angle and driving speed. Finally， with the experimental platform and test site provided by a new energy vehicle company， the path tracking effect of the improved MPC under complex road conditions and the model predictive control algorithm with constant longitudinal speed is compared and analyzed. The experimental results verify the effectiveness and superiority of the improved MPC， and indicate that the accuracy of the path tracking， the driving stability and the safety of vehicle are guaranteed.

title: 基于车辆视角数据的行人轨迹预测与风险等级评定
title_en: Pedestrian Trajectory Prediction and Risk Grade Assessment Based on Vehicle-Perspective Pedestrian Data
name: Zheyu Zhang,Lü Chao,Jinghang Li,Guangming Xiong,Shaobin Wu,Jianwei Gong
keywords: pedestrian trajectory prediction,pedestrian risk grade assessment,vehicle-perspective pedestrian data,long short term memory neural network,clustering analysis,support vector machine,
abstract: The commonly used pedestrian trajectory and risk prediction model based on roadbed-perspective data often cannot avoid complex modeling calculation and manual judgment. For succinctly and effectively predicting pedestrian trajectory and evaluating risk grade， a pedestrian trajectory and risk grade prediction model is created based on vehicle-perspective pedestrian data in this paper. The acquisition of vehicle-perspective pedestrian data， the prediction of pedestrian trajectory based on long-short term memory neural network and the assessment of risk grade based on clustering analysis - support vector machine method are successively conducted. The results of experiments show that the data-driven model built based on vehicle-perspective pedestrian data can capture the movement tendency and interaction characteristics of pedestrian and vehicle and is capable of predicting pedestrian trajectory and assessing risk grade.

title: 面向自动驾驶数据生成的风格迁移网络研究
title_en: Research on Style Transfer Network for Autonomous Driving Data Generation
name: Dafang Wang,Jingdong Du,Jiang Cao,Mei Zhang,Gang Zhao
keywords: GANs,style transfer,deep learning,autonomous driving,
abstract: The data abundance of the autonomous driving dataset is the key to ensuring the robustness and reliability of autonomous driving algorithm based on deep learning， but the amount of data with night scenes and various climates and weather conditions in current autonomous driving datasets are still very limited. In order to meet the application needs in the field of unmanned driving， a style transfer network is built， which can convert the current autonomous driving data into various forms such as night and snow， etc. The network adopts a structure of single encoder-dual decoder， combined with various means such as semantic segmentation networks， skip connections， and multi-scale discriminators to improve the quality of generated images with good vision effects. Deeplabv3+ semantic segmentation network trained by real data is used to evaluate the images generated and the results show that the mean intersection over union of the images generated by the network adopted is 2.50 and 4.41 percentage points higher than that generated by AugGAN and UNIT networks with double encoder-double decoder structure respectively.

title: DHSSA优化的K均值互补迭代车型信息数据聚类
title_en: K-means Complementary Iterative Vehicle Information Data Clustering Based on DHSSA Optimization
name: He Huang,Wenlong Li,Lan Yang,Huifeng Wang,Biao Wang,Feng Ru
keywords: KMC,screening maximum and minimum distance product,SSA,data sets,car type information data,
abstract: For the problems that the traditional method is greatly affected by the initialization center in the process of vehicle information data clustering， resulting in low clustering accuracy and poor robustness， and the selection of clustering center by calculating the mean in the iterative process is greatly affected by the outliers， a K-means complementary iterative vehicle information data clustering optimized by DHSSA is proposed. Firstly， for the problem of insufficient update of discoverer position and insufficient population diversity in SSA algorithm， a disturbance factor-head optimization strategy is designed. The influence of the optimal individual is strengthened by the adaptive head strategy， and the search space is expanded by the disturbance factor， which improves the accuracy of cluster center searching. Secondly， the initialization of cluster centers optimized by screening maximum and minimum distance product method （SMMP） is designed， and the screening mechanism is added on the basis of MMP， so that the initial centers are more evenly distributed in each cluster as much as possible. Finally， DHSSA and SMMP are integrated to optimize the K-means complementary iteration， which reduces the number of iterations and increases the search efficiency to obtain better clustering results. Using a variety of data sets for testing， through the convergence curve and performance indicators in the experimental results， it can be seen that the proposed DHSSA-KMC method is of higher search accuracy， convergence speed and lower clustering cost than SSA-KMC， IMFO-KMC， KMC and KMC++， and the time consumption is reduced compared with SSA-KMC and IMFO-KMC， which proves the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm. In the process of vehicle information data processing， DHSSA-KMC can efficiently cluster and generate competitive models for consumers to choose， with obvious application value.

title: EVCT对直喷汽油机燃烧和微粒排放的影响
title_en: EVCT on Combustion and Particulate Emission of Direct Injection Gasoline Engine
name: Fangxi Xie,Xianglong Meng,Yu Liu,Xiaona Li,Yulin Zhang,Haizhou Feng
keywords: direct injection gasoline engine,variable valve timing,ignition advance angle,particulates,engine performance,
abstract: This paper studies the effect of exhaust valve closing timing （EVCT） coupled with ignition timing （IT） on combustion， performance and particulate emissions of spark-ignited gasoline direct injection （GDI） engines under five different operating conditions. The results of the study show that the delay of EVCT leads to prolonged combustion duration （CA5-CA90） and delayed combustion center （CA50）. The advancement of IT can advance CA50 and shorten the combustion duration. EVCT combined with IT can effectively reduce engine fuel consumption and particulate emission， with a reduction of brake specific fuel consumption（BSFC） by 4.66% and the total number of particulates by up to 95%. With the increase of the load or speed， the impact of EVCT on particulate emissions and fuel consumption weakens.

title: 基于迭代动态规划的动力电池组热管理优化策略
title_en: Optimization Strategy of Thermal Management of Power Battery Pack Based on Iterative Dynamic Programming
name: Yan Ma,Jiayi Li,Qian Ma,Mingchao Chen
keywords: lithium-ion battery pack,iterative dynamic programming,concentrated heat model,liquid cooling system,battery thermal management,
abstract: During the driving of electric vehicles， the power battery continuously generates heat. Continuous high temperature will affect the battery life and the safety of the operation of electric vehicles. Therefore， it is necessary to adopt an efficient and energy-saving cooling optimization strategy in order to improve the efficiency of the power battery. Based on the heat generation characteristics of battery and Newton's law of cooling， a concentrated mass heat model of the battery pack is established in this paper， and compared with the battery liquid cooling model set up in AMESim to verify the accuracy of the model. In view of the high nonlinearity and time varying of the battery thermal management system， an iterative dynamic programming （IDP） strategy of iterative approximation of optimal control in multidimensional search space is proposed in this paper. Through the co-simulation of Matlab-AMESim， it shows that the proposed IDP optimization strategy can rapidly cool the temperature of the battery pack with minimum energy consumption， and the coolant flow rate is stable， which verifies the high efficiency and energy saving of the optimization strategy.

title: 基于梁单元简化模型的锂电池组碰撞安全临界条件的判定
title_en: Judgment of Critical Condition for Crash Safety of Lithium Battery Pack Based on Simplified Beam Element Model
name: Guang Chen,Chenyang Wei,Xiaoyu Li,Guoxi Jing
keywords: 18650 lithium battery,beam elements,simplified model,impact,critical conditions,
abstract: In view of the difficulty in applying the existing battery cell finite element model to vehicle crash analysis due to its large number of elements and low speed of calculation， a beam-element-based finite element model， reflecting the crushing and bending characteristics of cell housing is established. The effectiveness of the simplified model for battery cell is verified by comparing the results of axial crushing， radial squishing and indenting tests of battery cell. Simulations are conducted on the proposed simplified model of battery pack with 6 x 4 cells under two conditions： battery pack impacting rigid wall and rigid wall （steel plate in fact） impacting battery pack to determine the critical impact speed and critical mass of impactor leading to deformation and short-circuit failure of battery. The results show that in the condition of battery pack impacting rigid wall， the second and third rows of battery pack near rigid wall begin to fail when the impact speed reaches 245 km/h； while in the condition of rigid wall impacting battery pack， the cell starting to fail when the mass of impator larger than 16.06 kg is in the second row of battery pack near impactor. Therefore， the position of the battery cell first failing should be determined according to different impact conditions.

title: 铝基复合材料制氢性能与安全性研究
title_en: Study on the Performance and Safety of Aluminum Matrix Composite for Hydrogen Production
name: Yang Zhao,Kang Ye,Hanqiao Sun,Zunyan Hu,Liangfei Xu,Jianqiu Li,Minggao Ouyang
keywords: PEMFC,aluminum-water reaction for hydrogen production,hydrogen storage density,safety,
abstract: The technology of aluminum water electrolysis for hydrogen production has the advantages of high hydrogen storage density， safe and environmentally friendly， becoming one of the hydrogen production technologies with high compatibility and being able to meet the needs of hydrogen supply of fuel cell in special scenes. It is described in this paper that the aluminum matrix composite of 85%Al-9%LiAlH4-3%Bi-3%NaCl is produced with high-energy ball milling process， the hydrogen production performance in different scenes and its safety under special environment are studied， and the stable supply of hydrogen flow is achieved through the design and production of the device of aluminum-water reaction for producing hydrogen. The results show that at a temperature of 50oC， the maximum hydrogen output of aluminum matrix composite， which has a good fire resistance property shown by burning experiment， reaches 1，435 mL/g， and the device designed for aluminum-water reaction can fulfill a stable hydrogen supply with a flow rate of 0.8 L/min， meeting the operation demand of low-power fuel cell.

title: EMB夹紧力控制与传感器故障诊断研究进展
title_en: Research Progress of EMB Clamping Force Control and Sensor Fault Diagnosis
name: Qixiang Zhang,Liqiang Jin,Bohao Jin,Yihan Zhang,Pengfei Chen,Yongteng Liu,Jianhua Li
keywords: electro-mechanical braking system （EMB）,structure type,clamping force control,sensor fault diagnosis,
abstract: The electro-mechanical brake system （EMB） uses electronic control pure mechanical brake technology to realize various active safety control functions. It has the advantages of simple structure， rapid response， independent and precise control of wheel braking torque. To comprehensively sort out the development status of the EMB system and clarify its future technology trend， the structure of the EMB is introduced first， and the advantages and disadvantages of several typical structure types of the EMB are analyzed and main research directions in the future are determined. Then， the research progress at home and abroad is reviewed from two levels of clamping force control and sensor fault diagnosis. The development history and the focus of future research of clamping force control algorithms are analyzed， and the experiments’ results of three typical clamping force control algorithms are compared.Then， the specific types and functions of sensor fault diagnosis are introduced， and the actual control effect of different fault diagnosis algorithms is analyzed through quantitative indicators. Finally， the problems faced by the EMB system and future development trends are analyzed and prospected. It is pointed out that further research can be concentrated on improving the accuracy and robustness of algorithms of clamping force control and sensor fault diagnosis， etc.， the coordinated controlling of the EMB and wire-controlled chassis integrated control technology and the influence of the EMB on the stability and comfort of the vehicle.

title: 电液线控制动系统压力反步控制算法研究
title_en: Study on the Backstepping Control Algorithm for the Hydraulic Pressure in Electro-hydraulic Brake-by-wire System
name: Qin Shi,Xin Liu,Helie Ying,Mingwei Wang,Zejia He,Lin He
keywords: brake-by-wire,hydraulic pressure control,backstepping control,RBF neural network,Lyapunov stability,
abstract: In order to realize the accurate control of hydraulic pressure in brake-by-wire system， a new type of brake-by-wire system is developed in this paper. A control-oriented dynamics model of system is established through system dynamics analysis， and a backstepping control algorithm is designed based on that system model. A radial basis function network is used to approximate the characteristics of continuous function and estimate the non-linear friction， related to system state variables， as the compensation for backstepping controller， with the Lyapunov stability of the algorithm proved. An electro-hydraulic brake-by-wire test bench is built to conduct tests on several braking conditions and the results show that the control strategy designed can achieve the accurate control of hydraulic pressure in brake-by-wire system with fast response.

title: 针对ASR系统防误触的复杂路面识别算法
title_en: Complicated Road Surface Identification Algorithm with Prevention of ASR False Activation
name: Xichen Li,Hong Zhang,Xiaotian Xie,Bowen Wang,Xinyu Wang
keywords: vehicle engineering,ASR,uneven road surface,road surface identification,
abstract: The significant fluctuation of wheel speed affected by the dynamic load of uneven road surface （URS） can lead to jumps in wheel slip rate，which will frequently trigger the Acceleration Slip Regulation （ASR） with the slip rate as the control target. Therefore， it is necessary to identify uneven road surface and subsequently optimize the control strategy. For uneven road with bumps， an identification algorithm employing threshold logic method with the variation of slip rate and lateral camber angle as the judgement index. For continuous uneven road， an identification method integrates traversal counting method and energy method is adopted to determine the road condition and take the area enclosed by slip rate and road surface adhesion coefficient as the characteristic value to judge the adhesion condition of the road surface. Furthermore， ASR threshold adjustment control is used to mitigate the slip phenomenon caused by wheel suspension and the non-ideal yaw resulted from the active braking imbalance. The results indicate that the algorithm can identify the condition of URS rapidly and precisely with an 18.8% reduction of the active braking duration， minimizing the power loss when driving on URS.

title: 电动两轮车骑车人紧急避让姿态对损伤风险的影响研究
title_en: Research on the Effects of Emergent Avoidance Postures of Electric Two-wheeler Riders on Their Injury Risk
name: Yong Han,Liya Lin,Yong He,Di Pan,Hongyu Cai,Qian Peng,Hao Feng
keywords: electric two-wheeler,riders,emergent avoidance posture,ground impact injury risk,finite element analysis,
abstract: For investigating the kinematic response and injury differences of riders in different emergent avoidance postures， human finite element model THUMS is used to develop four driving postures， i.e. one normal posture and three emergent avoidance postures： struck side foot landing （SFL）， non-struck side foot landing （NSFL） and landing on both feet （LBF）. A simulation model for a car impacting electric two-wheeler and its rider is built with eight groups of simulations （combination of 20 and 40 km/h two speeds and 4 driving postures） conducted to comparatively analyze the head injury parameters （peak angular acceleration， peak linear acceleration， HIC15， intracranial pressure， CSDM0.15 and MPS） and the Von-Mises stress distribution in lower limbs， and to evaluate the ground impact injury risk of two-wheeler rider. The results show that with a vehicle speed of 20 km/h， the head injury of normal posture rider in ground impact exceeds AIS 4+， while the lower limbs injury of riders with all types of postures do not exceed the fracture threshold. With a vehicle speed of 40 km/h， the head-ground impact injury of riders with all types of postures exceeded AIS 4+， the rider with an emergent avoidance posture of LBF has the highest risk of head injury， the rider with a normal posture has the lowest risk of lower limbs injury， while the rider with an emergent avoidance posture of SFL has a risk of lower limbs fracture. This study clarifies the effects of different emergent avoidance postures on riders' injuries in ground impact and provides an important reference basis for automotive safety technology research.

title: 考虑噪声标签影响的驾驶员精神负荷状态评价
title_en: Evaluation of Driver's Mental Load State Considering the Influence of Noisy Labels
name: Jing Huang,Yang Peng,Ye Huang,Xiaoyan Peng
keywords: traffic safety,mental load,confidence learning,machine learning,noisy labels,
abstract: Most existing studies on driver’s mental load evaluation give the driver’s mental load classification label with the presence or absence of sub-tasks in driving scenes， but drivers may sometime fall into self-thinking， leading to the increase in their mental load in normal driving scenes. In addition， even the same driving sub-tasks may not have the same effects on the mental load of different drivers due to the discrepancy of individuals. As a result， there may exist some noisy labels in the data set collected by traditional methods， hence affecting the training results of the mental load evaluation models of drivers. In view of these problems， the method of confidence learning is adopted to process （detect and filter） the mental load classification labels of drivers in this paper. By using the processed labels， with electroencephalogram， electrocardiogram and skin electricity signal features as model inputs， the driver’s mental load models based on algorithms of support vector machine， random forest， K-near neighbor， decision tree， logic regression， and multi-layer perceptron are constructed to comparatively analyze the effects of noisy label processing on the enhancement of the performance of different models. The results show that after the noise label processing by using confidence learning， the performances of various driver’s mental load models constructed remarkably improve， among which support vector machine model achieves the best results in performance enhancement.

title: 基于结构轻量化的城市客车车身生命周期评价
title_en: Life Cycle Assessment of City Bus Body Based on Structural Lightweighting
name: Tong Wang,Yiqun Du,Yisong Chen,Rimei Han
keywords: city bus,finite element analysis,modal analysis,lightweight analysis,life cycle assessment,
abstract: The finite element model for a 12 m monocoque hybrid power city bus is created and the effects of body structure optimization on the energy-saving and emission reduction of the bus are analyzed through strength， stiffness and modal analyses as well as structural lightweighting and life cycle assessment. The results show that compared with original body skeleton， the mass of structurally optimized body skeleton reduces by 52.5 kg and both the strength and stiffness meet the requirements under bending and ultimate torsion conditions with a good natural vibration characteristic. As for the full life cycle， after lightweghting the mining resource consumption reduces by 0.4E04kg Sb-eq.， fossil energy resources consumption reduces by 0.7E04MJ and the overall environment influence factor reduces by 0.42E11， equivalent to a reduction rate of 3.81%， 4.46% and 4.56% respectively.

title: 注塑短纤维增强复合材料汽车尾门内板轻量化设计
title_en: Lightweight Design of Vehicle Tail-door Inner Panel Made of Injection Molded Short Fiber Reinforced Polymer Composite
name: Zeyang Li,Zhao Liu,Ping Zhu
keywords: vehicles,tail-door inner panel,injection-molded short-fiber-reinforced polymer composite,parameterized constitutive model,parallel optimization,lightweight design,
abstract: In this paper， a lightweight design procedure including the parallel optimization of material and structure is proposed for the inner panel of tail door made of injection-molded short-fiber-reinforced polymer composite in a car. A layered material model is built with consideration of the layered distribution feature of short fiber， on the basis of which a parameterized constitutive model for material is put forward to rapidly predict its mechanical performance when its parameters are changed. An extraction and mapping method for material parameters is proposed according to the distribution features of fiber orientation， so effectively enhancing the accuracy of structural analysis. Considering the design variables of material and structure， combined with Kriging surrogate model and boundary-searching based improved particle swarm optimization algorithm， a lightweight design procedure for composite tail door inner panel is proposed. As a final result， the parallel optimization of material and structure is fulfilled while assuring the design requirements for various working conditions with a lightweighting result of 10.5% mass reduction achieved.

title: 基于车辆动力学混合模型的智能汽车轨迹跟踪控制方法
title_en: Trajectory Tracking Control Method Based on Vehicle Dynamics Hybrid Model for Intelligent Vehicle
name: Peijun Fang,Yingfeng Cai,Long Chen,Yubo Lian,Hai Wang,Yilin Zhong,Xiaoqiang Sun
keywords: intelligent vehicle,trajectory tracking,data-driven modeling,model predictive control,
abstract: The vehicle dynamics modeling process based on mechanism analysis is usually simplified with assumptions，which can't accurately calculate the dynamic changes of actual vehicles under different road conditions， thus causing problems such as low trajectory tracking control accuracy and instability of intelligent automotive. To tackle the above-mentioned problems， this paper proposes a non-linear modeling and control method based on hybrid modeling technology. By constructing mechanism analysis - data-driven vehicle dynamics series hybrid model， the vehicle state and control data are calculated and processed by the mechanism model， and then used as the input of the data-driven module after a level combination. Besides， long-short-term memory network used as the backbone realizes the nonlinear correlation feature extraction of time-series data and the final model output calculation. The test results show that the model can supplement some unmodeled dynamics in the mechanism model， improve the model calculation accuracy and has the ability to implicitly understand different road adhesion conditions. In addition， the Euler integration is used to complete the discretization of the prediction model and design the model predictive control track tracking algorithm. The feedforward feedback control algorithm is designed to provide external input required by the prediction model in the horizontal control while realizing the longitudinal control of the vehicle， finally achieving more accurate trajectory tracking control effect that is more in line with the actual driving environment. The co-simulation results of Carsim / Simulink show that the method achieves accurate output of different road attachment coefficients， synchronously enhances the intelligent automotive trajectory tracking control accuracy and stability， and has good horizontal and longitudinal coordination control.

title: 基于非对称势场的人车协同博弈避撞
title_en: Human-Vehicle Cooperative Game Collision Avoidance Based on Asymmetric Potential Fields
name: Shaobo Lu,Feifei Xie,Bohan Zhang,Jiafeng Lu,Caixia Li
keywords: cooperative control,improved artificial potential field,non-cooperative game,trajectory tracking,stability control,
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of pedestrians and the stability of vehicle in the emergency pedestrian avoidance of human-machine co-driven vehicle， a human （driver）-vehicle cooperative game collision avoidance strategy based on pedestrian asymmetric potential field is proposed. Firstly， with full consideration of the street-crossing characteristics of pedestrian and his relative motion with vehicle， an asymmetric double elliptical pedestrian potential field is established for better characterize pedestrian risk， based on which the path planning for collision avoidance is performed. Then， for enhancing vehicle stability during collision avoidance and ensuring trajectory tracking performance， a non-cooperative game-based driver-AFS-ARS three-way synergy controller is constructed with a simulation on the condition of pedestrian avoidance is conducted for verification. The results show that with the ARS control added， not only the trajectory tracking performance in collision avoidance is ensured， the stability of vehicle is also apparently enhanced， with its average absolute value of error in lateral speed being 46.43% less than driver-AFS cooperative control.

title: 基于高效NMPC算法的无人车轨迹跟踪控制研究
title_en: Research on Trajectory Tracking Control of Unmanned Vehicle Based on Efficient NMPC Algorithm
name: Hongwei Wang,Chenyu Liu,Lei Li,Haotian Zhang
keywords: unmanned vehicle,trajectory tracking,nonlinear model predictive control,improved-C/GMRES,solution efficiency,
abstract: In view of the lowering of the trajectory tracking accuracy and the solution efficiency caused by the increase of nonlinear degree and dynamic constraints of unmanned vehicles under complex working conditions， an efficient algorithm based on nonlinear model predictive control （NMPC） is proposed in this paper. Firstly， in consideration of the nonlinear factors of the vehicle model， the dynamic model and the magic formula tire model are established. A terminal state is integrated to the performance index. The multi-constraint conditions within the stability range are added， and barrier function method is used to solve nonlinear inequality constraints to ensure the smoothness of the solution process. Then in order to reduce the computational burden caused by solving nonlinear optimization problems， an improved continuous/generalized minimum residual （improved-C/GMRES） algorithm is proposed. Compared with the traditional C/GMRES algorithm， the continuously increasing penalty factor is introduced to speed up the numerical calculation efficiency and reduce the computational burden of the algorithm. Finally， based on the joint simulation platform of Simulink and Carsim， the trajectory tracking accuracy and solution efficiency are verified in double-shift line motion and serpentine motion. Simulation results show that compared with the traditional C/GMRES algorithm， the proposed algorithm can significantly improve the tracking accuracy and driving stability of trajectory tracking， and greatly accelerates the solution efficiency.

title: 动态场景下基于语义分割与运动一致性约束的车辆视觉SLAM
title_en: Vehicle Visual SLAM in Dynamic Scenes Based on Semantic Segmentation and Motion Consistency Constraints
name: Shengjie Huang,Manjiang Hu,Yunshui Zhou,Zhouping Yin,Xiaohui Qin,Yougang Bian,Qianqian Jia
keywords: intelligent vehicle,simultaneous localization and mapping,semantic segmentation,dynamic scenes,motion consistency,
abstract: Traditional simultaneous localization and mapping （SLAM） methods for vehicles generally rely on the assumption of static environment， so the positional estimation accuracy may be decreased and the front-end visual odometer may even fail to track in dynamic scenes. This paper proposes a SLAM method for dynamic scenes by combining Fast-SCNN real-time semantic segmentation network and motion consistency constraints. Firstly， FAST-SCNN is used to obtain a segmentation mask of potential dynamic targets and remove the feature points to obtain a preliminary estimation of the camera position. Subsequently， based on the motion constraints and the chi-square test， the static points in the potential dynamic target are added again to further optimize the camera pose. The validation set test results show that the average pixel accuracy and mean intersection over union （mIOU） of the proposed semantic segmentation network is greater than 90%， with the processing time for 1 frame of picture is about 14.5 milliseconds， which meets the segmentation accuracy and real-time requirements of the SLAM system. Based on the public data set of TUM and real vehicle data set， the average performance improvement by using the proposed method exceeds by 80% over ORB-SLAM3 in various indicators， which significantly enhances the operating accuracy and robustness of SLAM in dynamic scenes and hence guarantees driving safety of intelligent vehicles.

title: 融合Lite-HRNet的Yolo v5双模态自动驾驶小目标检测方法
title_en: Small Target Detection Method for Dual-Modal Autonomous Driving with Yolo v5 and Lite-HRNet Fusion
name: Zilong Liu,Xiangfei Shen
keywords: automatic driving,object detection,infrared image,Yolo v5,small target,Lite-HRNet,
abstract: This paper proposes a Yolo v5 network fused with Lite-HRNet to solve the problem of missed detection in the current target detection algorithm for autonomous driving field when detecting small and dense targets. Firstly， in order to obtain high-resolution feature detection maps， Lite-HRNet is used as the backbone network of Yolo v5 to enhance the detection of small and dense objects. In order to improve the detection performance in dark scenes， the infrared image and the visible light image are dynamically weighted to give full play to the complementary advantages of the visible light image and the infrared image. Because of the sufficient feature fusion of the backbone network， in order to speed up the detection speed， the feature fusion structure in the detection layer is cancelled. Secondly， α-EIoU is used as the bounding box loss function in order to speed up the convergence and improve the regression accuracy. At the same time， the bisecting K-means algorithm is used for clustering to select more appropriate anchor boxes for the data set， and the small target data augmentation algorithm is used for sample expansion of the dataset. Finally， a comparative test with Yolo v5 on the flir dataset is conducted. According to the experimental results， the average detection accuracy of this algorithm is 7.64% higher than Yolo v5， and the missed detection rate of small targets and dense targets is significantly reduced.

title: 驾驶经验对L3级自动驾驶接管绩效的影响
title_en: Effect of Driving Experience on Take-Over Performance of L3 Automatic Driving
name: Linyan Wang,Huijun Zhang,Hongyu Hu
keywords: automatic driving,take-over performance,driving experience,
abstract: L3 level automatic driving system allows the driver to leave from driving tasks temporarily within its Operational Design Domain （ODD）. When the system reaches its boundary， it issues a Take-over Request （TOR）， alerting the driver to take over the vehicle in time. In order to explore the take-over performance of drivers with different driving experience in L3 automatic driving， emergency obstacle avoidance driving scenarios with non-driving tasks and visual assistance are designed for 24 participants of different ages with significantly different driving experience to carry out the take-over experiment on the driving simulator platform. The results show that different driving experience has no significant effect on reaction time， but there is significant difference in take-over performance. Experienced drivers have a significant improvement in the metrics like maximum steering wheel Angle and standard deviation of steering wheel Angle； i.e.， experienced drivers can resume the control of the vehicle more steadily and safely. In addition， the difference between experienced and inexperienced is more significant without visual assistance.

title: 基于混合神经网络的汽车运动状态估计
title_en: Estimation of Vehicle Motion State Based on Hybrid Neural Network
name: Zhenhai Gao,Wenhao Wen,Minghong Tang,Jian Zhang,Guoying Chen
keywords: vehicle state estimation,deep learning,gated recurrent unit,multilayer perceptron,hybrid neural network,
abstract: For the problem that the existing vehicle motion state estimation algorithm relies heavily on the accuracy of the dynamic model and the accuracy is difficult to guarantee under large slip angle， the paper proposes a vehicle motion state estimation algorithm based on the hybrid neural network （HNN）. By analyzing the basic dynamic characteristics of the vehicle itself， an hybrid neural network architecture suitable for vehicle motion state estimation is designed， and the deep learning estimation of vehicle motion state is realized. Based on the dataset composed of multi standard operating conditions and typical real vehicle test conditions， network training and test verification are carried out. The results show that compared with the traditional algorithm， the proposed HNN algorithm realizes estimation of vehicle motion state without dynamic vehicle model， improves estimation accuracy， and is robust to road adhesion coefficient change.

title: 基于VSL-MPC的半主动悬架预瞄控制研究
title_en: Research on Semi-active Suspension Preview Control Based on VSL-MPC
name: Xiaokai Chen,Mingkai Zeng,Xiang Liu,An Jiang
keywords: semi-active suspension,preview control,VSL-MPC,transient impact,continuous damping control damper,
abstract: On board sensors provide rich environment information for intelligent vehicles. However， in the electronically controlled suspension control algorithm， the road information perceived by vehicles has not been fully utilized， resulting in poor vehicle dynamics control effect. In this paper， a variable step length model predictive control （VSL-MPC） algorithm is proposed based on the high-performance preview control of semi-active suspension. The VSL-MPC algorithm determines the step length of preview control by real-time vehicle velocity and the road information collected by the binocular camera， so that the road perception information included in the control algorithm can reflect the road features more accurately， which is helpful for the semi-active suspension to adjust the damping characteristics of the suspension at a more appropriate time to realize a more ideal suspension decision-making control. The road profile information is collected by the binocular camera first. Then the optimal performance limit of semi-active suspension system is introduced as the performance evaluation benchmark， and four different semi-active suspension simulation models based on model predictive control are established. The results of simulation show that under the typical urban road conditions such as continuous deceleration belts and manhole cover impact， the performance gap between the VSL-MPC algorithm and the benchmark is only 0.72 and 2.33 dB， which are much smaller than 4.31 and 4.46 dB of traditional preview MPC algorithm， and 4.04 and 4.74 dB of non-preview MPC algorithm， when taking the vertical acceleration of sprung mass as the indicator. The VSL-MPC algorithm can enhance the dynamic performance of semi-active suspension effectively.

title: 基于无迹卡尔曼滤波和门控循环单元的道路坡度估计
title_en: Road Slope Estimation Based on Unscented Kalman Filtering and Gated Recurrent Unit
name: Datong Qin,Kang Wang,Jihao Feng,Yonggang Liu,Kun Cheng,Yu Xia
keywords: slope estimation,unscented Kalman filtering,gated recurrent unit,short-range slope,
abstract: In view of the poor universality of external lidar and other sensors， and the large error of traditional road slope estimation method based on onboard CAN bus data in four special conditions of vehicle， including starting， gear shifting， braking， and stopping， a road slope estimation approach based on unscented Kalman filter （UKF） and gated recurrent unit （GRU） is proposed. The working condition is determined according to vehicle speed and other data. Under non-special conditions， the vehicle dynamic model is established and UKF is used to estimate the slope. Under special working conditions， the time series slope with unstable-regularity is converted to the distance series slope， and GRU is used to estimate the short-range slope. The results of simulation and real vehicle tests show that under non-special conditions， the method proposed can accurately estimate the road slope using UKF， and under special conditions， the method can effectively track the changing trend of distance series slope through GRU， significantly enhancing the estimation accuracy of road slope.

title: 轮胎力学特性仿真高精度有限元建模方法研究
title_en: Research on High-Accuracy Finite Element Modeling Method for Tire Mechanics Characteristics Simulation
name: Dang Lu,Wenhao Yang,Haidong Wu,Nanshi Chen,Jian Cheng,Zhenwei Zhang
keywords: tire mechanical properties,finite element simulation,tire profile,
abstract: In order to enhance the tire finite element simulation accuracy and better meet the requirements of high-precision virtual sample delivery， a tire reverse analysis method is proposed. First， the section profile is acquired by 3D scanning of a real tire， which is then cut along radial direction to obtain a piece of tire section with certain thickness. Next， the thin tire section is put onto the print paper of tire section profile obtained by 3D scanning and make both section profile well coincide， which is then scanned to get a section picture of tire material layout as real profile， with which and designed profile acquired from tire manufacturer， two 3D tire model is generated by rotating section profile around tire center. Then both real tire test and finite element simulation on both tire models with real and designed profiles respectively are carried out under static condition. Finally， a comparative simulation on the static mechanics characteristics of tires with real and designed profiles under different tire pressures is conducted. The results show that the simulation accuracies of radial， lateral and longitudinal stiffness of tire with real profile reach 99.2%， 97.9% and 98.2%， i.e. 4.3， 4.6 and 7.4 percentage points higher than that of designed profile respectively， but the torsional stiffness of tires with two different profiles has little difference. Under all different tire pressures， the stiffness of tire with designed profile in all different directions always higher than that of real profile and they all increase with the rise of tire pressure.

title: 电动汽车热泵PTC耦合制热策略研究
title_en: Research on Heat Pump PTC Coupling Heating Strategy for Electric Vehicle
name: Hongzeng Ji,Jingyang Cai,Jinchen Pei,Xinglei He,Fen Guo,Yichun Wang
keywords: electrical vehicle,R134a heat pump,PTC,heating strategy,dynamic regulation,
abstract: In order to decrease the power consumption for EV heating， it is proposed that there are heating performance zones for heat pump system heating within the ambient temperature range of -20 to 5℃ based on the heating performance test of the heat pump system. The PTC coupling heating strategy of the heat pump with PTC involving in the low efficiency zone in advance is developed. The system model built by AMESim is used for simulation and the comparison study is conducted with the traditional strategy. Compared with the heat pump with 6 000 r/min rotary speed coupling 278.95 W PTC heating power， the heat pump with 4 700 r/min rotary speed coupling 462.11 W PTC heating power consumes 6.4% less energy to maintain the car temperature at 24 ℃。Compared with single heat pump heating， the heat pump coupling PTC heating strategy with PTC intervention in advance has the advantages of faster heating， lower energy consumption and lower rotary speed. When the ambient temperature is -10 ℃ and the target temperature in the vehicle is 20 ℃，the energy consumption in the regulation process can be reduced by 9.4% at most and by 2.8% after stabilization. When the strategy with PTC intervention in advance is adopted， the compressor speed should be maintained as close to the critical speed in the high efficiency zone as possible. The strategy can significantly improve the heating efficiency and comfort without changing the system structure.

title: 基于NSGA-Ⅱ算法和模糊控制的纯电动汽车2DCT换挡规律研究
title_en: Study on Shift Schedule of 2DCT for Pure Electric Vehicle Based on NSGA-Ⅱ Algorithm and Fuzzy Control
name: Xuebing Yin,Yong Chen,Qinglin Dai,Hai Liu,Naili Tian,Bolin He
keywords: pure electric vehicle,two gear dry dual clutch transmission,shift schedule,NSGA-Ⅱ algorithm,fuzzy control,
abstract: Shift schedule is a key factor affecting the economy and power performance of vehicle.For the independently developed two gear dry dual clutch transmission （2DCT） of pure electric vehicle， taking the shifting speed under different pedal opening as the optimization variable， the Pareto front of the shifting speed is obtained by NSGA-Ⅱ algorithm，and the shift schedule considering both economy and power performance of pedal opening and speed is obtained by linear weighting method. A three-parameter fuzzy controller is constructed by introducing in acceleration to dynamically adjust the shifting speed， and the comprehensive shifting schedule is obtained. The results show that the comprehensive shift schedule can take into account the economy and power performance of the vehicle simultaneously， and reduce the shift frequency greatly compared with the economic shift schedule.

title: 基于大数据的电动汽车行驶阶段碳减排影响因素分析
title_en: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Carbon Emission Reduction in the Driving Stage of Electric Vehicles Based on Big Data
name: Weipeng Zhan,Zhenpo Wang,Junjun Deng,Peng Liu,Dingsong Cui,Haitao Li
keywords: electric vehicles,carbon emission,driving stage,emission reduction,
abstract: Based on a large number of real vehicle data in China， this paper analyzes the impact of energy structure changes， battery capacity degradation， operating conditions， temperature， purpose， battery charging efficiency， vehicle transmission efficiency and other factors on carbon emission reduction of electric vehicles （EVs）， and establishes a carbon emission model of EV driving stage. According to the national and provincial dimensions， this paper analyzes the reasons for the regional differences in carbon emission reduction of EVs， and studies the emission reduction benefits of different types of EVs. Sensitivity analysis is carried out on the influence of electricity carbon emission factor， climate and temperature on carbon emission reduction of EVs. Finally， based on the analysis results， suggestions are put forward for the low-carbon development path in the field of road transportation.

title: 车辆小重叠碰撞中滑移模式的研究
title_en: Study on the Slid Mode in Vehicle Small-Overlap Frontal Crash
name: Xiaojie Chen,Song Li
keywords: small-overlap frontal crash,slide value,theoretical model,neural network,sensitivity analysis,
abstract: Based on the plane motion theory， a theoretical analysis method for the slide mode of the vehicle in small-overlap frontal crash is proposed， and the relationship between the slide value and the impact forces is revealed and verified by experiments and tests. The impact area is divided into six parts and the sixth-order impact force characteristic curves are put forward. Based on the characteristic curves and the uniform design method， the sample space of vehicle slide value and different characteristic curves is obtained by using the theoretical method proposed. Furthermore， the BP neural network is established to conduct a sensitivity analysis of the impact forces and the vehicle slide value in the six regions of characteristic curves， with the critical impact region under that working condition identified. The theoretical method proposed and the sensitivity analysis conducted provide a theoretical support for the structural design for small-overlap frontal crash.

title: 基于深度学习的座椅抗挥鞭伤性能预测
title_en: Prediction on Seat’s Anti-whiplash-injury Performance Based on Deep Learning
name: Shaowei Zhang,Dawei Zhu,Guangzhao Zhai
keywords: seat anti-whiplash performance,deep learning,neural network,finite element simulation,BioRIDII,Pam-Crash,
abstract: On the base of traditional simulation and combined with deep learning， a rapid prediction method of seat’s anti-whiplash injury performance is proposed. Firstly， a series material level， component level， subassembly level and seat level static and dynamic physical experiments are carried out on a Shanghai VW’s vehicle seat. Then using the results of experiments to calibrate the existing simulation model， resulting in the effectiveness of the simulation model verified. Next， a simulation on all factors affecting the seat’s whiplash performance is conducted by using full-factor method， and based on simulation results and using deep learning method， a long- and short-term memory （LSTM） neural network model is established to rapidly predict the whiplash injury response of dummy. The results show that the dummy response curve obtained from prediction by LSTM neural network model agrees well with simulated curve， so can be used in subsequent seat’s whiplash performance optimization.

title: 基于粒径分布的直喷汽油车颗粒物排放特性研究
