Besides， at -40 ℃， adding a 110 kW·h TES device can increase the driving range by 115.5% and adding an 8 kW·h TES device can shorten the warm-up time by 65%. This study provides a new thermal management paradigm with both technical feasibility and economical rationality for the large-scale promotion of electric buses in cold regions， and is of great significance for promoting the comprehensive electrification of public transport in high latitude regions.

title: 四轴重载无人车辆电液全轮转向系统设计与路径跟踪方法研究
title_en: Design and Path Tracking Method of Electrohydraulic All-Wheel Steering Systems for Four-Axle Heavy-Duty Unmanned Vehicles
name: Yi Chen,Xiangyu He,Xiliang Zhou,Houlu Fan,Zhuoyu Wu
keywords: four-axle heavy-duty vehicle,unmanned driving,electrohydraulic AWSS,path tracking,
abstract: Four-axle heavy-duty unmanned vehicles （FHUVs） is a new type of special engineering vehicle characterized by multiple axles， high load bearing and large turning radii； thus， research on all-wheel steering system （AWSS） has become challenging. In this paper， an electrohydraulic AWSS for a new type of FHUV is designed， and path-tracking methods are researched. Firstly， a two-degree-of-freedom model （2-DOF） of a FHUV is constructed， and a new type of electrohydraulic AWSS is designed on the basis of analysis of the steering resistance and axle structure. Then， a path tracking method based on a preview control sliding mode controller （PSMC） is proposed to achieve precise control of the four-axle wheel angle of the vehicle. Finally， on the basis of different working conditions， the research content of this study is verified via a joint simulation model. In order to verify the stability and feasibility of the electrohydraulic steering system， an experimental platform is built， which demonstrates the good dynamic performance of the system.

title: 平面搭接自冲铆接铝合金接头的成形质量和力学性能研究
title_en: Research on the Forming Quality and Mechanical Properties of Flat-Surface-Overlapped Self-piercing Riveted Aluminum Alloy Joints
name: Chao Wang,Wanyuan Yu,Aiguo Cheng,Zhicheng He,Tao Chen
keywords: aluminum,FS-SPR,forming quality,mechanical properties,finite element simulation,
abstract: A flat-surface-overlapped self-piercing riveting （FS-SPR） process is proposed to improve the joint quality in joining thick aluminum alloy sheets using self-piercing riveting （SPR）. Firstly， five different joints are fabricated to study the effect of riveting distance， overlap distance， and overlap surface type. Secondly， the mechanical properties and failure behavior under quasi-static and fatigue loads of FS-SPR joints are investigated through quasi-static and fatigue tests. Finite element simulation is conducted to study the forming mechanism of the FS-SPR process and explore the influence of process parameters on the forming quality of the FS-SPR joints with an inclined overlap surface. The results show that J1， J3， and J4 joints can form good mechanical interlock， while joint J2 fails to form mechanical interlock due to inadequate lower sheet thickness， and J5 joint experiences rivet bending due to large stack thickness. The simulation result shows that the overlap length needs to exceed 40 mm， the riveting position should be to the right of the middle， and the optimization of sheet thickness and rivet length is necessary to improve forming quality. Well-designed J1 and J3 joints outperform the traditional overlapped J5 joint. The peak force and energy absorption of J5 joint are 1.7% and 28.6% lower than J1 joint， and 10.7% and 6.4% lower than J3 joint， respectively. When subjected to the same load level， the fatigue life of J3 joint is on average 70% higher than that of J5 joint.

title: 面向大角度座椅研发的后倾坐姿乘员损伤仿生模型开发及验证
title_en: Development and Validation of Injury Bionic Models for Occupants in Reclined Seating Posture for Large-Angle Seat Design
name: Haiyan Li,Shengjiao Zhang,Yanxin Wang,Xinyu Zhang,Shihai Cui,Lijuan He,Wenle Lü
keywords: reclined occupants,injury biomechanic model,the 5<sup>th</sup> percentile Chinese female,the 50<sup>th</sup> percentile Chinese male,large-angel seat,
abstract: The rapid promotion of intelligent vehicles has expanded application scenarios for large-angle zero-gravity seats， presenting new challenges for the design of occupant restraint system. For the limitation of current crash test dummies in assessing occupant safety in reclined seating postures， based on the TUST IBMs F05 （5th percentile female） and TUST IBMs M50 （50th percentile male） occupant injury bionic models， a biomimetic model of occupant injury in reclined seating postures is developed in this study through posture adjustment reconstruction. The effectiveness of the model is verified by reconstructed cadaver tests. The test results indicate that the displacement-time curves of both models fall within the cadaveric response corridors. Additionally， the models accurately represent the thoracolumbar spine and pelvis geometry of the human body， while also exhibiting detailed soft tissue structures with high geometric realism and good mesh quality. With a high level of biofidelity， this model provides reliable baseline data for studying the injury mechanisms of reclined occupants in crashes， as well as for developing safety protection strategies and related regulations. Furthermore， it serves as an efficient computational tool for the development， safety assessment， and comfort evaluation of large-angle automotive seats.

title: 基于GAN-FCNN数据增强的特种车辆声品质预测研究
title_en: Research on Sound Quality Prediction of Special Vehicles Enhanced with GAN-FCNN Data
name: Kun Qian,Xikang Du,Yanfu Wang,Jiying Duan,Ke Liu,Jing Tan,Zhenghua Shen,Jian Zhao
keywords: data enhancement,special vehicle,sound quality,GAN,oversampling,
abstract: For the special vehicle sound quality prediction， the cost of collecting noise samples is high， and only a small number of sample sets can be obtained after sample processing， lacking sufficient noise samples， which affects the model accuracy during the training of various prediction models. In this paper， a GAN-FCNN network is established， and a four-layer fully connected layer is used to construct a generator and discriminator for adversarial training， and a pseudo-sample set is generated. The enhanced sample set is introduced into the LASSO linear regression model and the RF， BP and PSO optimization models respectively for regression prediction. Through verification， the prediction accuracy and performance of the models are improved. Compared with the traditional oversampling algorithm， the GAN-FCNN network has higher accuracy， which is more suitable for sample expansion in the establishment of special vehicle sound quality prediction model.

title: 基于改进无延迟频域算法的汽车风噪主动控制研究
title_en: Research on Active Control of Automotive Wind Noise Based on Improved Delayless Frequency Domain Algorithm
name: Huijun Ji,Chihua Lu,Wan Chen,Zhien Liu,Ying Wang,Yongliang Wang,Menglei Sun
keywords: automobile wind noise,active control of wind noise,delayless frequency domain algorithm,secondary path equalization,variable step size in frequency segmentation,
abstract: Wind noise is one of the main sources of interior noise in high-speed driving of new energy vehicles. Wind noise control by traditional structural design has problems such as difficulty in control and unclear noise reduction effect. In this article， an improved delayless frequency domain filtering active noise control algorithm based on secondary path equalization and frequency domain segmented variable step size method. This algorithm has the characteristics of lower computational complexity and less frequency dependence on system noise reduction performance compared to traditional filtering minimum mean square （FxLMS） algorithms， and can achieve good noise reduction effect over a wide frequency range. A dual channel simulation model of the algorithm is built in SIMULINK to simulate the noise reduction control effect of broadband wind noise， and a wind noise active control test bench is set up in a semi anechoic chamber for testing and verification. The results show that based on the wind noise data measured in real vehicles under high-speed conditions， the improved delayless frequency domain filtering algorithm proposed in this paper has significantly better noise reduction effect than the traditional FxLMS algorithm， with the noise reduction of about 9.42 dB（A） and 8.81 dB（A） at two target positions. This research result can provide new ideas and methods for active control and application of automotive wind noise.

title: 轻量化铝陶制动盘在新能源汽车上的应用研究
title_en: Research on the Application of Lightweight Aluminum-Ceramic Brake Discs in New Energy Vehicles
name: Liuxu Cao,Henghu Wang,Shuhai Huo,Qiuer Chen,Lexiao Tao,Yiming Ma,Xiaofeng Yang,Xin Ding,Zhaoru Jiang,Chunxuan Liu,Qingsong Dai,Xiaoyong Zhang
keywords: aluminum-ceramic brake disc,bench test,road trial,corrosion resistance,
abstract: In the context of carbon peaking and carbon neutrality， the demand for lightweight in new energy vehicles is increasingly urgent. As a critical component， the lightweight design of brake discs not only reduces unsprung weight but also enhances the vehicle energy efficiency and handling. Compared with the traditional cast iron brake discs， aluminum ceramic brake discs have obvious advantages in terms of comprehensive performance， and also show a certain degree of competitiveness in terms of production efficiency and cost-effectiveness， gradually becoming an alternative choice for the industry to focus on. However， there is limited research on bench tests and road tests of aluminum-ceramic brake discs under real working conditions and the performance evaluation of them in new energy vehicles is not comprehensive. Therefore， in this study the performance of aluminum-ceramic brake discs is comprehensively verified and analyzed for the first time through bench tests， road trials， and corrosion resistance tests. The results show that aluminum-ceramic brake discs outperform cast iron discs in terms of friction coefficient stability， with a nominal coefficient maintained between 0.3 and 0.35. Additionally， the aluminum-ceramic brake discs can withstand temperature up to 500 ℃， significantly higher than previously reported. During a long downhill test in the Heishan Valley， with energy recovery turned off， the maximum temperature of the aluminum-ceramic front and rear brake discs is 83 and 108 ℃ lower， respectively， than those of cast iron brake discs. The road trials and corrosion resistance tests show that aluminum-ceramic brake discs perform excellently in terms of noise， vibration， wear resistance， and corrosion resistance， with an estimated service life of up to 1 million kilometers， demonstrating good adaptability， reliability， and durability in extreme environment and road conditions. This research not only provides a more reliable braking system solution for new energy vehicles but also contributes to energy-saving and emission reduction， promoting sustainable development of the new energy vehicles.

title: 碳纤维共混对碳纸性能调控的影响
title_en: Influence of Carbon Fiber Blending on the Performance Regulation of Carbon Paper
name: Zhilong Chang,Hui Chen,Jin Tao,Weiyu Cao,Zhigang Shen
keywords: carbon paper,polyacrylonitrile carbon fiber,pitch-based carbon fiber,in-plane resistivity,tensile strength,air permeability,power density,
abstract: The impact of doping different proportions （0， 5%， 10%， 25%， and 50%） of pitch-based carbon fiber on the properties of polyacrylonitrile （PAN）-based carbon paper is implored in this study. The microstructure， mechanical， electrical， gas transport， and electrochemical properties of the carbon paper are systematically characterized using scanning electron microscopy （SEM）， tensile strength measurements， in-plane resistivity measurements， air permeability tests， pore size distribution analysis， polarization curves， power density measurements， and electrochemical impedance spectroscopy （EIS）. The results show that doping pitch-based carbon fiber can significantly reduce the in-plane resistivity of the carbon paper， decreasing from 7.2 mΩ·cm to 2.0 mΩ·cm at a doping ratio of 50%. The tensile strength exhibits a trend of increasing followed by decreasing with increasing doping ratio， reaching the peak of 18.5 MPa at a 10% doping ratio， an approximately 176% increase compared to the undoped sample. The air permeability shows a trend of decreasing followed by increasing with increasing doping ratio， and the pore size distribution changes accordingly. Membrane electrode assembly （MEA） and single-cell tests indicate that the carbon paper doped with 5% pitch-based carbon fiber exhibits the best electrochemical performance， including lower electrochemical impedance and higher power density， attributed to its excellent water management capability. The findings reveal the regulatory effect of pitch-based carbon fiber doping on the properties of PAN-based carbon paper， providing a reference for optimizing the performance of gas diffusion layers of fuel cells.

title: 基于用户数据的整车结构耐久“试验场-用户”关联特性分析
title_en: Research on Vehicle Structural Durability Based on User Data and the Correlation Between “Proving Ground and User”
name: Lihui Zhao,Xiaoyu Xu,Shuo Weng,Dongjian Liu,Dongdong Zhang
keywords: user-operated big data,structural durability,condition characterization,proving ground and user association,
abstract: Current structural durability specification of the proving ground fail to fully capture the complex load characteristics under the actual user operating conditions， which results in a discrepancy between the proving ground conditions and the actual user use. In this study the characteristics of user structural durability are analyzed based on user big data. Furthermore， the characteristics of the 'proving ground-user' correlation are studied. Firstly， the user data is subjected to preprocessing， and a multivariate time-sequence adaptive segmentation method is employed to construct user-operating segments. The characteristic parameters of operating segments are constructed from three perspectives： time domain， frequency domain and damage. Subsequently， linear and nonlinear methods are employed for feature parameter dimensionality reduction. K-Means clustering is employed to categorize the data into six typical operating conditions. For each typical operating condition， operating characteristics， damage contributions， and inter-city variations in user data are analyzed. Finally， a similarity analysis is conducted to map the relationship between the proving ground reinforced pavement and typical operating conditions. Differences in damage targets， power spectral densities， and extrapolated rain flow are analyzed， and the reasons for the differences are explored through the joint ‘damage level-speed’ distribution. The findings provide a foundation for selecting structural durability test conditions， defining life cycle objectives， and improving proving ground specifications under user conditions.

title: 考虑预期功能安全的智能汽车自动紧急制动系统
title_en: Intelligent Vehicle Autonomous Emergency Braking System Considering Safety of the Intended Functionality
name: Dongkui Tan,Gangjun Hu,Bo Zhu,Lai Jin,Jie Zhang
keywords: SOTIF,AEB,STPA,perceptual blind scenes,optimal safe speed,disturbance observer,sliding mode control,
abstract: The proposed safety of the intened functionality （SOTIF） has challenged the safety of traditional automatic emergency braking （AEB） system. To deal with it， this paper uses systems-theoretic process analysis （STPA） to obtain the SOTIF requirements of the AEB. On the basis of the traditional AEB， a safety speed planning strategy for the perceptual blind scenes is added. Then， based on the kinematics model of the encounter between the vehicle and the pedestrian in the perceptual blind scenes， the formula of blind scenes safe speed is constructed. Then a speed sliding mode controller with a nonlinear disturbance observer is designed to track and control the speed. Finally， the simulation test is carried out on the joint platform of CarSim and Simulink to compare the safety of the proposed system with the automatic emergency braking system without the intended functional safety requirements， which is further verified via the hardware-in-the-loop experiment. The results show that the AEB considering the SOTIF can effectively reduce the risk of pedestrian collision and ensure the efficiency of vehicles passing through blind spots safely.

title: 基于行人视野注意力场的人车微观交互模型
title_en: Pedestrian-Vehicle Micro-Interaction Model Based on Attention Field of Pedestrian Vision
name: Wenli Li,Kaiwen Xiao,Xiaohui Shi,Fenghua Liang,Ping Li
keywords: pedestrian-vehicle interaction,pedestrian crossing style,pedestrian attention field of vision,artificial potential field,
abstract: From the perspective of pedestrian visual cognition， a pedestrian-vehicle micro-interaction model based on the atten-tion field of pedestrian vision is proposed. The attention field of pedestrian vision is constructed to drive the pedes-trian field of vision， and the artificial potential field is used to drive the pedestrian movement，. The target capture algorithm is used to control the target capture in the pedestrian visual field. In order to verify the effectiveness of the model， drones are used to collect the pedestrian-vehicle interaction data from the bird's-eye perspective and analyze them. Pedestrian crossing styles are divided into three types： conservative， cautious and adventurous. Simulation scenarios and interactive models are built on the Pygame platform， then， different types of interactive data are used as the model input， the similarity between the pedestrian spatiotemporal trajectory output by the model and the collected real spatiotemporal trajectory is experimentally compared. The results show that the pedestrian-vehicle mi-cro-interaction model based on pedestrian visual attention field is 25.48% more accurate than the conventional artifi-cial potential field model， and it can effectively reproduce the pedestrian-vehicle interaction process in the actual traf-fic scene.

title: 基于自然驾驶数据的城市交叉口纵向驾驶特征分析
title_en: An Analysis on Longitudinal Driving Characteristics in Urban Intersection Based on Natural Driving Data
name: Tian Yuan,Xuan Zhao,Rui Liu,Qiang Yu,Xichan Zhu,Shu Wang
keywords: urban intersections,driving behavior,ANOVA,hierarchical regression,natural driving data,human-like driving,
abstract: In order to meet the higher requirements of driver assistance systems for human-like driving ability in urban intersection， the longitudinal driving characteristics of drivers in real traffic in that area are investigated in this paper. 778 sample data of drivers approaching urban intersections are extracted from natural driving data， and YOLOv4 is applied to identifying various types of road users in traffic scene. ANOVA is used to investigate the differences in reaction characteristics across motion types and traffic densities， and hierarchical regression models are established to analyze the relationships between braking characteristics and motion state， motion type and road users. The results show that high-density traffic significantly reduces approaching speed. Compared with right-turning drivers， stopping drivers have longer reaction distance and may approach intersection with higher acceleration and braking intensity in a shorter time with braking started 4.46s earlier when approach speed is higher or reaction distance is shorter. Different road users have different effects on braking characteristics： stopping drivers primarily pay attentions to the vehicles traveling in the same direction， and right-turning drivers are mainly concerned with pedestrians and cyclists.

title: 基于分段优化的车辆换道避障轨迹规划
title_en: Trajectory Planning of Intelligent Vehicles in Lane Change for Collision Avoidance Based on Segmented Optimization
name: Bin Tang,Zhanxiang Xu,Haobin Jiang,Yingfeng Cai,Zitian Hu,Zhengyi Yang
keywords: intelligent driving,lane change for collision avoidance,trajectory planning,segmented optimization,nonlinear programming,
abstract: In order to enhance the safety and comfort of intelligent vehicle during lane change for collision avoidance under complex road scenes， a trajectory planning method of intelligent vehicle lane change for collision avoidance is proposed based on segmented optimization. Firstly， according to the state of ego vehicle and multiple sampling points， candidate y-x curve clusters and x-t curve clusters are generated based on quintic polynomials with consideration of various possibilities of lane change. Then， by designing an obstacle risk evaluation function based on exponential function， and combined with the smoothness， altruism and driving efficiency of the trajectory， a comprehensive evaluation system is constructed to select the optimal reference trajectory， providing the direction and speed references for intelligent vehicle lane change for obstacle avoidance and preventing the solution from falling into local optimum in trajectory optimization. For suiting to the time-varying features of the obstacle movement state， the piecewise quintic polynomial y-x curve and x-t curve are constructed with the reference trajectory as a guide， and the optimization objective function is also established with consideration of the risk of collision with obstacle vehicles， converting the trajectory optimization problem into a constrained nonlinear programming one to find out the optimal trajectory by exterior point method. Finally， the simulation verification is performed on MATLAB platform with a result showing that the trajectory planning method proposed enhance the environmental adaptability and obstacle avoidance adjustment ability of vehicles， while meeting the requirements of lane-change smoothness and ride comfort.

title: 基于OEDR和ODC的自动驾驶汽车实际道路测试评价技术研究
title_en: Research on the Test and Evaluation Technique of Real Roads for Automated Driving Vehicles Based on OEDR and ODC
name: Hang Sun,Zhijun Li,Linlin Zhang,Zhenyu Chen,Shilong Li
keywords: automated driving,real road,test and evaluation,standardization,
abstract: In this paper， a classification method of test roads is proposed based on the object and event detection and response （OEDR） task of the automated driving system， the road element fundamental model is constructed based on the operation design domain， and the effective Jaccard similarity method is modified for the conformity assessment of test road. In addition， a test and assessing method based on the boundary of operation design condition is also put forward according to the selection of test road， and combined with occupant subjective evaluation， a test and evaluation system for automated driving vehicles on real road is built. The results of test on typical roads in China show that the test and evaluation system proposed has good feasibility and universality， being able to be widely applied as a standardized method.

title: 基于凸优化的燃料电池汽车节能驾驶研究
title_en: Research on Eco-driving of Fuel Cell Vehicles via Convex Optimization
name: Xiaodong Wei,Bo Liu,Jianghao Leng,Xingyu Zhou,Chao Sun,Fengchun Sun
keywords: fuel cell vehicle,eco-driving,convex optimization,speed planning,energy management,
abstract: In order to realize eco-driving of fuel cell vehicles in the multi-signal scenario， a fast speed planning and energy management method based on hierarchical convex optimization is proposed in this paper. Combined with the static hydrogen consumption map of the vehicle， dynamic programming is used to obtain the optimal period of green light for the vehicle while passing through the traffic light， and to determine the search area for the optimal driving route. A quadratic programming problem is established to obtain the acceleration with the minimum accumulated power demand as the optimization objective， and the Matlab/OSQP solver is used to obtain the optimal driving path of the vehicle. According to the optimal driving route， an energy management strategy based on the alternating direction method of multipliers is established to realize the reasonable distribution of the output power of each power source. The simulation results for the scenario with 9 traffic lights show that the average efficiency of the motor operating point of the proposed method is 10% higher， and the hydrogen consumption is 45% lower than that of the intelligent driver model. In addition， the method has fast calculation speed and the potential for real-time optimization.

title: 汇流排产热影响下的电池模组冷却系统改进设计
title_en: Improved Design of Battery Module Cooling System Under the Influence of Busbar Heat Generation
name: Yuming Peng,Mingxiao Yuan,Zhuoxin Jing,Yonglin Zhang,Gang Huang
keywords: square lithium-ion battery,Busbar,COMSOL Multiphysic,liquid cooling system,
abstract: In this paper， a reliable cell heat generation model is established by using Bernardi heat generation rate equation through simulation and experimental verification， and the simulation and experimental error is less than 2%. Based on this， the heat generation model of the module under the influence of the bus-bar heat generation is established. For improved design of the original cooling system for insufficient cooling effect on the top area of the module and the bus bar， for the cooling plate arrangement， it is proposed to install the cooling plate on the side of the module， and then to select the appropriate cooling plate thickness， cooling fluid volume concentration and the coolant inlet velocity through simulation analysis. In the final design， the average temperature rise of the bus-bar of the cooling system module， cell and top surface of the module is reduced by 15.56%， 11.48% and 20.34% respectively， and the temperature distribution on the cell of the module is more uniform.

title: 动态条件下基于深度学习的锂电池容量估计
title_en: Capacity Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery Based on Deep Learning Under Dynamic Conditions
name: Guihong Bi,Xu Xie,Zilong Cai,Zhao Luo,Chenpeng Chen,Xin Zhao
keywords: lithium-ion battery,capacity estimation,CNN,GRU-RNN,deep learning,
abstract: In the aging course of lithium-ion battery， nonlinear complicated changes occur inside the battery， therefore directly using the operation data of lithium-ion battery such as current， voltage and temperature in certain time sections to conduct real-time estimation on the battery state of health under dynamic condition is a challenging issue. In this paper， the random charging and discharging data of lithium-ion battery are selected， the time and frequency features of some segments of dynamic data are extracted to compose time and frequency feature matrices as input， a cascaded convolutional neural network and a gated recurrent unit capacity estimation model are constructed to extract the intrinsic features of input data， and the related features of each time sequence are further explored to fulfill the estimation of battery capacity under dynamic condition. The results of experimental verification utilizing NASA's lithium-ion battery random use data set show that the method adopted can accurately estimate the capacity of lithium-ion battery under the condition of only the nominal capacity of battery is known. Finally， the effects of the setting of model’s hyper-parameters， the time-sequence length of raw data， network input and model structure on the accuracy of battery capacity estimation are analyzed.

title: 车辆乘员主动脉钝性损伤仿真分析
title_en: Simulation Analysis on Blunt Aortic Injury of Vehicle Occupants
name: Fang Tong,Xiong Li,Fengchong Lan,Jiqing Chen
keywords: collision,driver,blunt aortic injury,steering wheel,fluid-solid coupling,
abstract: The refined heart aorta model established earlier are filled with blood based on the fluid-cavity function of software Abaqus， a blood-heart aorta liquid-solid coupling model is constructed， and the fluid exchange with different flow rates are set on aortic valve according to the pressure difference between left ventricle and aorta. Simulations on the frontal crash of driver against steering wheel are carried out under different working conditions to analyze the effects of the cardiac blood output and the inclined angle of steering wheel on the blunt aortic injuries of driver. The results show that ：（1） The blood flow from left ventricle to aorta reduces the peak blood pressure of left ventricle and alleviated the blood pressure fluctuations in the aorta， but the effect on the maximum stress of aorta is not significant； （2） When the tilted angle of steering wheel is 30°， the maximum stress in the aorta reaches 2417 kPa， which is caused by the pressing of anterior chest wall on ascending aorta； （3） When the tilted angle of steering wheel is 60°， the maximum stress in the aorta lowers to 1375 kPa， which is caused by the relative tensile displacement between aortic root and descending aorta.

title: 自相似分层蜂窝结构多碰撞工况耐撞性研究
title_en: Study on Crashworthiness of Self-Similar Hierarchical Honeycomb Structure Under Multiple Collision Conditions
name: Fangwu Ma,Hao Sun,Hongyu Liang,Wenting Ma,Qiang Wang,Yongfeng Pu
keywords: honeycomb structure,self-similar hierarchical design,oblique collision,crashworthiness,
abstract: Enlightened by horsetail plant， a bionic self-similar hierarchical honeycomb structure is proposed in this paper. Based on the finite element model verified by test， the crashworthiness performance of the novel and traditional honeycomb structures under multi-angle oblique collision conditions are comparatively analyzed， including deformation modes， stress-strain curves and energy absorption characteristics. The results show that the self-similar hierarchical honeycomb structure has stable deformation mode under both ideal frontal and oblique impact conditions， and stable and excellent energy absorption performance when the impact angle changes.

title: 基于Euro NCAP典型工况的儿童行人下肢损伤评估方法研究
title_en: Research on Assessment Method of Lower Extremity Injury of Child Pedestrian Under Typical Conditions Specified in Euro NCAP TB024
name: Haiyan Li,Kun Li,Yongqiang Huang,Lijuan He,Shihai Cui,Lü Wenle,Shijie Ruan
keywords: vehicles,child pedestrian protection,car-pedestrian crash,lower extremity injury,
abstract: In this paper， the finite element models for the front-end structure of four typical vehicles， i.e. family car （FCR）， multi-purpose vehicle （MPV）， roadster （RDS） and sport utility vehicle （SUV） specified in Pedestrian Human Model Certification （TB024） of the Euro NCAP protocol and a finite element model for six-year-old child pedestrian with detailed anatomical and structural features are used to simulate the child pedestrian-car crash accident with the effects of the structural parameters of vehicle front-end on the lower extremity injuries of children pedestrians analyzed under typical conditions. The results show that the RDS causes the fractures in the greater trochanter of impact-side femur of children pedestrians due to the smaller ground clearance of the front edge of engine hood， and the high ground clearance of the spoiler in MPV and SUV leads to the more severe injuries in tibia， fibula and knee ligament of lower limbs. Finally a parameter of sectional bending moment of long bones is proposed for assessing the lower extremity injury of six-year-old child pedestrian based on the simulation results， providing references for the development and digital assessment of child's leg impactor.

title: 基于动态稳定域的车辆横纵向稳定性协同控制
title_en: Cooperative Control of Vehicle Lateral and Longitudinal Stability Based on Dynamic Stability Region
name: Sensen Cong,Feng Gao,Shucai Xu
keywords: horizontal and vertical coordination,dynamic stability region,vehicle stability control,sliding mode control,
abstract: The transverse and longitudinal stability control of chassis is one of the important aspects of vehicle safety. According to the transverse and longitudinal parameter characteristics of the vehicle in the stability region， based on the stability analysis of dynamic region and the corresponding stability controller， a transverse and longitudinal cooperative stability control method is designed. Firstly， the stability analysis method is established based on the traditional vehicle foundation stability region； secondly， a dynamic stability region suitable for different vehicle working conditions is constructed， so that the stability region does not need to be re-estimated for different steering angles and vehicle speeds； on this basis， a stable amplitude limiting control algorithm is designed； finally， taking the sliding mode surface as the boundary of the stability region， a dynamic sliding mode controller is designed to keep the vehicle state stable all the time. Through the joint simulation of Matlab/Simulink and CarSim， the effectiveness of the transverse and longitudinal stability control method is verified in the high-speed steering scene and double line shifting scene.

title: 基于车辆动力学响应特征的越野地面分类方法
title_en: Cross-Country Road Classification Method Based on Vehicle Dynamic Response Characteristics
name: Jian Zhao,Yaxin Li,Jing Tong,Bing Zhu,Weixiang Wu,Bohua Sun,Jiayi Han
keywords: off-road terrain,terrain classification,classification post-processing,vehicle response,machine learning,
abstract: Terrain classification based on vehicle dynamic response is one of the key technologies of off-road intelligent vehicles. In this paper， a method of off-road terrain classification， combining the terrain roughness features and mechanical characteristics， is proposed， with the sand， dirt， cement and snow roads classified. In this method， the equivalent terrain profile and the vertical acceleration of vehicle body are selected as the characteristics of terrain roughness， with the driving resistance and wheel speed fluctuation as the mechanical characteristics， the cross-country road classifier is designed based on LSTM model， and the training and testing are conducted on the cross-country driving dataset of vehicle. The results show that the correct rate of terrain classification reaches 95.5%. Finally， the post-processing of classification is fulfilled by using HMM model to solve the issue of the abrupt change of continuous data， enabling the correct rate of the algorithm in terrain classification with off-road continuous data rises from 88.44% to 90.13%.

title: 基于FPSC-FxLMS算法的车内发动机噪声主动控制
title_en: Active Control of Engine Noise in Vehicle Based on FPSC-FxLMS Algorithm
name: Yansong He,Hao Jiang,Zhifei Zhang,Tao Zhou
keywords: engine,active noise control,FPSC-FxLMS,Command-FxLMS,order noise,
abstract: The key to active noise control is to accurately estimate the amplitude and phase of the controlled noise. PSC-FxLMS algorithm adds the phase information of noise signal onto the Command signal and thus can emit a smaller anti-noise than Command-FxLMS algorithm does， but it is restricted by the estimation accuracy of secondary path and the phase extraction speed of Fourier transform. Taking the engine noise in a SUV as the object of research， the filter PSC-FxLMS （FPSC-FxLMS） algorithm is proposed in this paper， and with the noise information collected at the 4 seat headrest positions in the SUV as the primary noise， a simulation is conducted to compare the effects of the FPSC-FxLMS algorithm proposed and Command-FxLMS algorithm in the concurrent control of 2nd and 3rd order engine noise. Then a real vehicle test is also carried out on another SUV based on DSP hardware platform to compare again the effects of two algorithms. The results show that in controlling the engine noise at the left and right ear positions of the driver and the occupant behind driver， the anti-noise amplitude of 4th order noise with the algorithm proposed is lower than that with Command-FxLMS algorithm by over 25% in 800 r/min idle condition， while the anti-noise amplitude of 2nd order noise with the algorithm proposed is lower than that with Command-FxLMS algorithm by over 50% in a 1 900 r/min no-load condition. So it is demonstrated that the FPSC-FxLMS algorithm proposed can rapidly and accurately extract the phase information of engine noise at different rotational speeds， enabling the speaker emit a smaller anti-noise than the Command-FxLMS algorithm does.

title: 基于Payne效应的膜式空气弹簧非线性动刚度模型
title_en: Nonlinear Dynamic Stiffness Model of Rolling-Lobe Air Spring Based on Payne Effect
name: Mingyu Wu,Zhigang Chen,Hao Tong,Jing Wang,Hang Yin,Wenbo Zheng,Yao Li,Zhen Yu,Yintao Wei
keywords: Payne effect,thermodynamics,hysteretic characteristics,nonlinearity,
abstract: In this paper， a nonlinear dynamic stiffness model of rolling-lobe air spring with consideration of the Payne effect of the rubber and the hysteresis characteristics of the thermodynamic equivalent stiffness and damping is proposed to overcome the difficulty in modeling the nonlinear dynamic stiffness of air spring and provide a theoretical basis for the structural design and material selection of rolling-lobe. Firstly， parameter identification is conducted for the real and imaginary parts of dynamic stiffness by indicator diagram test， showing that the Payne effect of rubber causes the increase of dynamic stiffness under small amplitude with the correctness of the model under the excitations with different amplitudes and frequencies verified. Then， the physical explanation of the changing trend of the contribution of each decoupled variables is given from the two dimensions of amplitude and frequency. The results indicate that due to the Payne effect of the rubber， the real part of dynamic stiffness reduces and its imaginary part increases first and then gradually reduces with the increase of amplitude. And due to the stiffness of air and the equivalent damping generated by heat exchange， the real part of dynamic stiffness gradually increases and its imaginary part increases first and then reduces with the increase of frequency. Finally， a new evaluation indicator reflecting the contribution ratio of the dynamic stiffness of the rubber lobe is given， which can directly characterize the low-amplitude dynamic performance and the rationality of structural design and material selection of air spring. The test results indicate that this indicator obviously reduces with the increase of amplitude， so the dynamic stiffness at low amplitude generated by rubber lobe should not be ignored.

title: 基于三维/一维强耦合模型的整车热平衡与热系统参数对性能影响的研究
title_en: Research on Vehicle Thermal Balance and the Effects of Parameters on Thermal System Performances Based on 3D/1D Strongly Coupled Model
name: Yingchao Zhang,Jiesong Jian,Jintao Zhang,Guohua Wang,Yuanbin Yu
keywords: thermal management system,strong coupling,multi-dimension,multiple performance indicators,system parameters,
abstract: The parameter changes of the vehicle thermal management system affect its performances， so it is necessary to use new methods to concurrently study multiple performance indicators in different dimensions. In this paper， an 1D/3D strongly coupled model of the vehicle thermal management is constructed by using the AMESim and the STAR-CCM+. This model can study various performances including the 3D and 1D temperature and flow fields under different thermal balance conditions at the same time. The corresponding 1D analysis results show that the heat dissipation capability of the cooling system is the worst under climbing condition， and the refrigeration capacity of the air conditioning system is the worst under idle condition. In order to study the influence of the parameter changes of thermal management system on its performance， the effects of the fan and water pump speeds on the cooling capacity of cooling system under climbing condition， and the influence of the fan and compressor speeds on the refrigeration capacity of air conditioning system under idle condition are analyzed.

title: 基于全生命周期分析的白车身选材方法
title_en: Selection of Body-in-White Material Based on Life Cycle Assessment
name: Lijun Zhang,Ze Gao,Haiyan Yu
keywords: life cycle assessment,light-weighting material,carbon emission,energy consumption,
abstract: In this paper， life cycle assessment method is adopted to analyze the equivalent carbon emission and energy consumption of a fuel vehicle with four different materials i.e. common steel， advanced high strength steel （AHSS）， aluminum alloy and carbon fiber reinforced polymer （CFRP） as the material of its body-in-white in different stages of production， use （driving operation） and recovery after discard， with the influences of driving mileage on the emission reduction effects of different materials discussed. The results show that under current technical conditions， using AHSS and aluminum alloy to replace common steel as the material of body-in-white can reduce carbon emission and energy consumption， while using CFRP to replace common steel may increase the carbon emission and energy consumption. The life cycle carbon emission of aluminum alloy mainly depends on that in its production stage， while the selection of material is related to the carbon emission and energy consumption level in the region： in the region with general carbon emission and energy consumption level， aluminum alloy is superior than AHSS， while in the region with high carbon emission and energy consumption level， AHSS is superior than aluminum alloy. With the increase of driving mileage， the emission reduction effects of aluminum alloy become more remarkable. In a condition that the driving mileage of the fuel vehicle reaches 150 thousand km， it will get the comprehensively optimum carbon emission and energy consumption level when the materials of its body-in-white have a proportion of 77.9% AHSS versus 22.1% aluminum alloy.

title: 基于专家策略行为克隆的高速NOA强化学习研究
title_en: Research on High-Speed NOA Reinforcement Learning Based on Expert Strategy Behavior Cloning
name: Kegang Zhao,Jiayi Li,Jie Ye,Runlin Zeng
keywords: autonomous driving,planning control,behavior cloning,reinforcement learning,
abstract: Taking the high-speed navigation assistance driving （NOA） as the research object， for the problems of difficult strategy convergence and insufficient planning and control performance of traditional reinforcement learning （RL） algorithms in high-speed road scenarios， a reinforcement learning framework based on behavior cloning （BC） pre-training （BCRL） is proposed. This method utilizes expert prior knowledge to alleviate the low exploration efficiency caused by sparse rewards， and enhances the safety and generalization ability of the model's decision-making. Firstly， a parametric curve planning algorithm is adopted as the expert strategy to conduct planning and control in generalized high-speed scenarios and generate a diverse driving dataset. The behavior cloning pre-training is completed by combining the gated recurrent unit （GRU） encoding and decoding network. Secondly， the pre-trained network is used as the initial policy network of the proximal policy optimization （PPO） algorithm， and the policy is fine-tuned in the natural driving environment （NADE）. In this stage， a sheared PPO update mechanism based on generalized advantage estimation （GAE） is introduced to iteratively optimize the policy in high-risk conditions such as close following， forced lane change by the preceding vehicle， and dangerous lane change. Through verification on the OnSite platform， the experimental results show that in the high-speed scenarios of the NADE environment， BCRL significantly improves the planning and control performance compared to the pure RL method， reducing the collision rate by 89.50% and increasing the target achievement rate to 89.60% （32.31% for pure RL）. At the same time， BCRL outperforms the pure BC model in terms of safety， efficiency， and comfort， and demonstrates good generalization ability in tests on the highway-env， HighD， and OnSite datasets.

title: 基于结构化意图建模的自动驾驶类人性决策策略研究
title_en: Research on Human-Like Decision-Making Strategies for Autonomous Driving with Structured Intent Modeling
name: Jiqing Chen,Zeli Chen,Fengchong Lan,Yunjiao Zhou
keywords: autonomous driving,human-like decision making,intent modeling,Transformer,
abstract: As autonomous driving systems place increasing emphasis on human-likeness， interpretability， and behavioral consistency， achieving stable and coherent decision-making strategies has become a pressing challenge. Traditional reinforcement learning methods often struggle with issues such as policy instability， action oscillation， and erratic behavior in complex traffic environment. Therefore， this paper proposes a deep reinforcement-learning algorithm of Consistent Intent Soft Actor-Critic （CINTSAC）， which introduces a structured intent modeling mechanism to enhance the consistency， coherence， and semantic interpretability of learned strategies. Based on the Soft Actor-Critic （SAC） framework， CINTSAC integrates a Transformer encoder to perform semantic modeling over multi-frame trajectory state. Additionally， a self-supervised intent path is introduced to explicitly capture the temporal evolution of the ego vehicle’s behavioral intent. A smoothness regularization term in the latent space is designed to constrain policy output， thereby reducing the occurrence of non-human-like be havior and improving structural stability. The experiments conducted on the CARLA simulation platform， under diverse maps and perception noise conditions， demonstrate that CINTSAC significantly outperforms PPO， SAC， and TRSAC in terms of average speed， success rate， and lane-change smoothness， exhibiting superior stability， generalization， and human-like behavior.

title: 面向量产自动驾驶域控制器多传感器同步方法研究
title_en: Research on Multi-sensor Synchronization Methods for Mass Production Autonomous Driving Domain Controller
name: Ming Wang,Bingfeng Xu,Jie Sun,Chaoran Yang,Yuze Li
keywords: autonomous driving,multi-sensor fusion,time synchronization,domain controller,mass production,generalized precision time protocol,
abstract: For the challenges of high-precision synchronization and cost control for multi-sensor systems in the mass production of autonomous driving， this paper proposes a highly integrated synchronization solution for the mass production domain controller platform. This method takes the Global Navigation Satellite System （GNSS） as the master clock of the generalized Precision Time Protocol （gPTP） to construct a globally unified time reference. The system takes the domain controller as the core， after synchronizing with the GNSS， it uses the built-in hardware timer to generate precise trigger signals， directly driving the camera exposure and Inertial Measurement Unit （IMU） sampling. Meanwhile， LiDAR achieves microsecond-level time synchronization by receiving GNSS PPS （Pulse Per Second） and Serial Data signals. For the non-ideal factors in hardware triggering， this paper establishes a timing model that includes camera exposure delay and introduces in a dynamic lookahead compensation method. The real vehicle experiments show that on a single domain controller， the synchronization accuracy between LiDAR and camera is less than 100 microseconds， and between LiDAR and IMU is less than 50 microseconds. To further verify its engineering value， this study has conducted comparative tests under the same hardware and algorithm conditions in highway， urban road， and tunnel scenarios. The results show that this scheme improves the average accuracy of target detection （mAP） by approximately 5.8%， and reduces the number of identity switches （ID Switch） in target tracking by approximately 40%. Especially in GNSS short-term loss-of-lock scenarios， based on the system's ability to maintain hardware timer timing， the synchronization accuracy remains better than 200 microseconds. This scheme has been implemented in a production project. Compared with the traditional scheme， it can reduce the synchronization hardware cost by approximately 66%， providing an engineering feasible technical path for improving the perception robustness of the autonomous driving system.

title: 网联交通环境下多车道合流区时空协同优化控制方法
title_en: Spatiotemporal Collaborative Optimization Control Method for Multilane Merging Areas in Connected Traffic Environment
name: Xiancai Jiang,Cong Xu,Xinyue Zhang
keywords: intelligent transportation system,merging control,multi-objective genetic algorithm,multilane merging area,dynamic lane,flow balancing,
abstract: For the joint optimization problem of spatial resources and merging sequences in multi-lane merging areas， this paper proposes a spatio-temporal collaborative optimization control method for multi-lane merging areas （SCOM-MMA） in connected traffic environment. The optimization framework adopts a two-layer structure： the upper layer considers the penetration rate of connected and autonomous vehicles （CAVs）， with the objective of maximizing the capacity of the merging area and the constraint of balancing the flow rate ratio of each lane， dynamically dividing the functions of lanes and optimizing the adjustment of traffic flow in each lane. The lower layer considers the compliance rate of connected human-driven vehicles （CHVs）， and for the two traffic scenarios of CAV-only lane merging and mixed driving lane merging， with the objective of improving efficiency and reducing fuel consumption and the constraint of vehicle operation safety. The multi-objective genetic algorithm NSGA-II is used to optimize vehicle trajectories， achieving coordinated control of merging vehicles. The simulation results show that compared with only trajectory optimization， the SCOM-MMA strategy based on flow rate balance combined with trajectory optimization can increase the average speed of each lane in the merging area by 13.37%. Compared with the first-in-first-out （FIFO） strategy and the flow balance （FB） strategy without flow rate optimization， the SCOM-MMA strategy has more significant optimization effect under high traffic and low CAV penetration rates， with an increase of average speed of 38.18% and 27.24% respectively， and average fuel consumption reduction of 30.57% and 23.57% respectively. Compared with the game theory-based GT-CCSR strategy， the average speed increases by -4.76% to 36.25%， and the average fuel consumption decreases by 33.65% to 66.45%. Further research shows that the penetration rate of CAVs and the compliance rate of CHVs are the key factors affecting the performance of this method， with the optimization performance showing a significant improvement trend with the increase of both.

title: 基于ADASIS地图重构的重型商用车预见性自适应巡航控制
title_en: Predictive Adaptive Cruise Control Based on ADASIS Map Reconstruction for Heavy Duty Commercial Vehicle
name: Chenxi Liu,Zhiguo Zhao,Tao Li,Wenchang Li
keywords: heavy-duty commercial vehicles,predictive adaptive cruise control,ADASIS map,dynamic programming,fuel economy,safe following,
abstract: To enhance the fuel economy and safe following performance of heavy commercial vehicles， this paper proposes a predictive adaptive cruise control （PACC） strategy by fully integrating predictive cruise control （PCC） and adaptive cruise control （ACC）. Firstly， a longitudinal dynamics model of heavy commercial vehicles， a following vehicle model and a fuel consumption model are established. A real-time road slope update and interpolation algorithm based on trajectory （TRGUIA） is designed to reconstruct the ADASIS map and obtain the road slope information required for the PACC strategy. Secondly， the motion prediction information of the preceding vehicle and the expected following indicators are incorporated into the PCC fuel-saving optimization model， and the PACC strategy is proposed. The optimal economic speed sequence is solved by the dynamic programming algorithm， and the target reference speed is output according to different logics based on the decision mode. Finally， the offline simulation tests and real vehicle road tests are carried out. The simulation results show that the PACC strategy can achieve a fuel saving rate of 5.01% compared with the constant speed cruise control （CC）， and can reduce fuel consumption by 4.76% compared with the adaptive cruise control （ACC）， and reduce the standard deviation of vehicle speed changes by 26.3%. The real vehicle test results show that the PACC strategy can improve fuel economy by 7.64% compared with CC， and can increase the fuel saving rate by 1.56% to 5.12% compared with experienced drivers. At the same time， the speed planned by this strategy in the following vehicle condition is more stable， which can effectively meet the following vehicle performance requirements of commercial vehicles.

title: 主备冗余域控制的无人矿卡自适应SMPC轨迹跟踪策略研究
title_en: Research on Adaptive SMPC Trajectory Tracking Strategy for Unmanned Mining Vehicles with Master-Slave Redundant Domain Control
name: Ying Li,Xiaohan Li,Wei Xiong,Yifan Sun,Junqiu Li
keywords: unmanned mining vehicle,domain control network,trajectory tracking,switched model predictive control,redundant control,
abstract: This paper proposes a switched model predictive control （SMPC） trajectory tracking strategy with a fault-tolerant redundancy mechanism for domain-controlled unmanned heavy-duty mining transport vehicles. Firstly， two predictive models of different complexity—kinematic and dynamic—are established. A multi-dimensional control constraint and cost function are proposed， taking into account of actuator performance， tracking accuracy， and stability boundaries. An adaptive weight regulator based on error feedback and preview curvature is constructed to enhance the adaptability and stability of the trajectory tracking strategy under varying working conditions. Furthermore， a redundancy mechanism is introduced for the chassis domain controller to maintain tracking control performance in the event of a failure in the intelligent driving domain's tracking control function， which ensures that even under fault conditions， the vehicle's tracking performance remains within an acceptable range. Finally， offline simulation demonstrates that compared to nonlinear model predictive control strategies， the proposed method achieves comparable tracking performance while improving real-time responsiveness. The hardware-in-the-loop simulation results show that the proposed strategy enhances trajectory tracking accuracy and stability under vehicle cornering conditions， meeting the vehicle tracking accuracy requirements of real transport scenarios. In the event of sudden control function failures， stable docking can be achieved.

title: 面向结构化城市路网的混合动力汽车深度强化学习节能驾驶研究
title_en: Research on Deep Reinforcement Learning-Based Ecological Driving of Hybrid Electric Vehicles in Structured Urban Road Networks
name: Xiaolin Tang,Yuqi Cheng,Jiaxin Chen,Wei Yang
keywords: hybrid electric vehicle,deep reinforcement learning,energy management,energy-saving driving,structured urban road networks,
abstract: To enhance the energy-saving effect of intelligent connected vehicles in structured urban road networks， this paper takes parallel hybrid electric vehicles as the research object and proposes a deep reinforcement learning-based multi-objective optimization method that integrates energy-saving routes， longitudinal speed， and energy management. Firstly， for the urban road network traffic scenario， by integrating the global link and multi-lane traffic signal features， an energy-saving path planning is achieved through the deep value network algorithm. Secondly， a traffic signal safety model and a vehicle following safety model are established to determine the vehicle's safe driving speed threshold. Thirdly， a dual deep reinforcement learning framework based on the deep deterministic policy gradient algorithm and the soft actor-critic algorithm is constructed to achieve the collaborative optimization of driving speed and energy management strategies. Finally， a hierarchical collaborative optimization algorithm integrating path， traffic signal and vehicle following scenarios is proposed. The effectiveness of the proposed algorithm is verified through simulation experiments. The results show that the strategy proposed in this paper improves the vehicle's fuel economy while ensuring driving safety and comfort.

title: 电动汽车两挡变速器方案与换挡控制研究综述
title_en: A Review on Two-Speed Transmission Scheme and Shift Control of Electric Vehicles
name: Junnian Wang,Chunlin Zhang,Zidong Zhou,Zhen Zhai,Changyang Guan,Yitong Wang
keywords: electric vehicles,two-speed transmission,scheme classification,shift actuator,shift without power interruption,
abstract: The two-speed transmission represents one of the optimal solutions for balancing powertrain complexity against performance enhancement in electric vehicles. To comprehensively examine the current state of this technology and identify future trends， the paper firstly classifies two-speed transmissions into two primary schemes based on layout of centralized two-speed transmission and distributed two-speed transmission. Then， these categories are further subdivided according to shift actuator type and motor arrangement for detailed analysis of representative designs and development trajectories. For the core challenge of shift control without power interruption， the paper critically analyzes three principal methods of clutch sliding control， coaxial multi-source power compensation， and non-coaxial multi-source power compensation， including their operating principles， comparative advantages and disadvantages， and suitable application scenarios. Finally， the paper summarizes recent advances in key technologies related to two-speed transmissions and offers perspectives on future development direction.

title: 面向人车冲突场景的车辆紧急制动-转向避险策略研究
title_en: Research on an Integrated Emergency Brake-Steer Avoidance Strategy for Vehicle-Pedestrian Conflict Scenarios
name: Danqi Wang,Yao Huang,Lin Hu,Tiefang Zou,Lintao Wu
keywords: vehicle-pedestrian collision,integrated brake-steer avoidance,co-simulation,active vehicle control,
abstract: To reduce pedestrian head injury risk in vehicle–pedestrian collisions， this paper proposes a brake–steer integrated emergency avoidance strategy for conflict scenarios. An optimization framework is established by coupling vehicle braking–steering control parameters， a vehicle kinematic model， a multi-objective optimization algorithm， and a multibody dynamic model， implemented through ISIGHT， MATLAB， and MADYMO co-simulation. The framework coordinates longitudinal braking， lateral motion， and steering constraints to achieve avoidance while maintaining vehicle stability. Through a total of 2，982 simulation calculations， a comparative analysis is conducted under three avoidance strategies of full braking， controlled braking， and brake–steer joint optimization strategies in terms of pedestrian kinematics and head injury outcome for different vehicle types. The results indicate that the controlled braking substantially reduces head injuries due to ground impact， whereas the integrated brake–steer strategy mitigates both vehicle-contact and ground-impact injuries. Compared to full braking with passenger cars， the Head Injury Criterion （HIC） decreases by approximately 92%–95% under controlled braking and 95%–99% under the integrated strategy. These results demonstrate that brake–steer joint optimization can markedly attenuate pedestrian head injury in typical collision scenarios. The proposed framework highlights the effectiveness of proactive collision avoidance and offers guidance for the engineering development of advanced active vehicle control systems.

title: 基于强化学习的全线控分布式驱动车辆横摆-侧倾稳定性控制
title_en: Yaw-Roll Stability Control for Full X-by-Wire Distributed Drive Vehicles Based on Reinforcement Learning
name: Qin Li,Zhihang Xie,Tianyang Wang,Yong Wang,Boyuan Zhang,Yong Chen
keywords: full X-by-wire distributed drive vehicles,additional yaw moment,anti-roll moment,reinforcement learning,stability control,
abstract: For the insufficiency of roll compensation and the contradiction of real-time decision-making in complex operational scenarios for all-wheel-controlled distributed drive vehicles （Robo-Car）， this paper proposes a yaw-roll moment coordinated decision-making and torque decoupling control method based on reinforcement learning （MLC-RL）. This method aims to combine the end-to-end decision-making advantage of reinforcement learning， eliminate the dependence of traditional control on explicit models， effectively improve computational efficiency， and utilize the passive anti-roll mechanism of hub motor reaction torque to compensate for the mechanical limitation of this vehicle type without active suspension， thereby achieving real-time coordinated control of vehicle yaw-roll stability. MLC-RL adopts a hierarchical architecture. The upper layer is based on a reinforcement learning policy network， directly learning the coordinated decision-making of additional yaw moment and anti-roll moment from CarSim vehicle dynamic data. The lower layer realizes four-wheel torque distribution through torque decoupling control. The MATLAB/Simulink-CarSim co-simulation results show that this method effectively guarantees the yaw stability of Robo-Car while significantly improving the roll suppression performance and ride comfort， providing an effective solution for the stability control of all-wheel-controlled distributed drive vehicles.

title: 基于路面识别的NSGA-II权值优化主动悬架MPC控制
title_en: NSGA-II Weight Optimization for Active Suspension MPC Control Based on Road Surface Identification
name: Farong Kou,Xiaona Jiang,Runpeng Zhang,Longlong Xing
keywords: road surface identification,NSGA-II,model predictive control （MPC）,active suspension system,multi-objective optimization,weight optimization,
abstract: For the problems of insufficient detection of local pulse excitation on the road surface in vehicle suspension systems and the performance limitation caused by the empirical setting of model predictive control （MPC） weight， this paper proposes a hierarchical control architecture for active suspension based on lightweight semantic segmentation and multi-objective dynamic optimization. By constructing a road surface image dataset， a lightweight DeepLabV3+ network with MobileNetV2 as the backbone network is used for real-time semantic segmentation. Based on a 1/4 vehicle model， an MPC controller is designed， and the NSGA-II algorithm is used to offline optimize and generate Pareto optimal weight sets for six typical road surfaces. During actual driving， the trained neural network is used to identify the road surface in real time， and the optimal control parameters are dynamically matched to achieve online adaptive control of the suspension system. The results show that the semantic segmentation road surface recognition algorithm based on DeepLabV3+ can efficiently and accurately identify various road surface conditions. Compared with the ResNeSt-MPC and fixed-weight MPC control strategies， the variable-weight MPC control strategy designed in this paper can adjust the control parameters according to the road surface conditions and effectively improve the suspension performance on random road surface. Under the impulse road surface condition， the system adjustment time is shortened by more than 25%， improving the ride comfort of the suspension.

title: 面向底盘运动性能优化的半主动悬架深度强化学习控制策略
title_en: A Deep Reinforcement Learning Control Strategy for Semi-Active Suspension for Chassis Motion Performance Optimization
name: Guoying Chen,Xinyu Wang,Xizhou Zhang,Peng Wang,Shiqi Cong,Zhenhai Gao
keywords: semi-active suspension,deep reinforcement learning,nonparametric reward function,multi-objective optimization,
abstract: Semi-active suspension system as the core component of vehicle chassis intelligent control， its damping characteristics of dynamic adjustment ability directly determines the comfort and handling stability of the vehicle driving process， which plays a crucial role in the optimization of intelligent chassis motion performance. Traditional algorithms in semi-active suspension control rely on model accuracy and the time-varying characteristics of vehicle parameters can easily lead to model mismatch， weakening the control robustness under complex working conditions. In recent years， the introduction of deep reinforcement learning （DRL） algorithms in the control of semi-active suspension has shown great potential. However， DRL algorithms mostly focus on the improvement of ride comfort of semi-active suspension， and the fragile convergence characteristics of the algorithms have been the main challenges in this field. In this paper， a deep reinforcement learning control strategy for the optimization of chassis kinematic performance of semi-active suspension is proposed， and a non-parametric reward function DQN algorithm is designed based on the inverse tangent function （NRDQN）. By designing the non-parametric reward function， the control strategy can better cope with the uncertainty of the system， and take into account the maneuvering stability and driving comfort of the vehicle while ensuring the convergence speed of the training. The HIL experimental verification results show that in the Slalom condition with mixed road surface excitation， the root mean square （RMS） value of the roll angle is suppressed by 1.86%， and the ride comfort is improved by 11.8%. The NRDQN strategy exhibits good transferability and robustness both on different driving road surfaces and in the Slalom condition.

title: 半主动悬架车辆俯仰抑制控制策略研究
title_en: Research on Pitch Suppression Control Strategy for Semi-Active Suspension Vehicles
name: Yixia Lu,Lu Xiong,Wei Han,Wei Wei
keywords: semi-active suspension system,vehicle pitch suppression,continuous damping control,fuzzy PID control,
abstract: During driving， vehicles usually experience pitching motion due to factors such as acceleration， braking or road excitation， which not only affects ride comfort but also poses a threat to the health of passengers and driving safety. Based on the background of intelligent chassis technology， this paper takes the continuous damping control shock absorber as the control object and uses the Simulink and CarSim co-simulation platform to comparatively analyze the control effect of multiple control strategies. The simulation results show that the fuzzy PID combined with skyhook control algorithm innovatively proposed in this paper performs the best in suppressing the pitching motion of the vehicle. Under the set working conditions， the variance of the body pitching angle is reduced by 58.3% compared with the passive suspension， with the vertical performance also improved in a coordinated manner. This paper provides a theoretical basis and technical support for the design and improvement of vehicle suspension systems， showing broad application prospect and practical engineering value.

title: 车辆振动对锂离子电池净放电容量影响的实验研究
title_en: Experimental Study on Vehicle Vibration Effect on the Net Discharge Capacity of Lithium-Ion Batteries
name: Yunfeng Zhi,Zhichao Hou,Wenxiang Li,Ping Zhang
keywords: lithium-ion batteries,vibration,power spectrum discharge,net discharge capacity,
abstract: This study tries to investigate the effect of vehicle vibration on the performance of a soft-pack ternary lithium-ion battery in terms of net discharge capacity. The target cells are divided according to the experimental configurations into three groups， namely vibrational， static and free ones. The first two groups are subjected to the same initial pressure， but differ from each other in whether or not subjected to vibration during discharging. The cell of the third group is under a free condition without external pressure during discharging. The cycling test power spectrum recommended in the IEC 62660-1 standard for pure electric vehicles is used to perform short-term discharge cycles on each group of batteries separately. During the discharge process， the cells of the vibration group are excited according to the spectrum specified in the GB 38031 standard along the normal direction of the battery large surface. Based on the test data， the net discharge capacity or its average value of each group of batteries is calculated and compared. The results indicate that， compared to the free group， the cell in the static group exhibits a decrease of about 0.8% in net discharge capacity， while the cells in the vibration group have an average decrease of 1.2%. The reduction of both groups is independent of the number of cycles. It is also demonstrated that the net discharge capacity and its variation are more suitable than the usable capacity for evaluating vibration effect on the performance of soft pack batteries.

title: 基于改进iTransformer-AFEKF算法的锂离子电池荷电状态估计
title_en: State of Charge Estimation for Lithium-Ion Batteries Based on Improved iTransformer-AFEKF Algorithm
name: Qin Shi,Xinnan Fu,Weilu Hou
keywords: state of charge,lithium-ion batteries,adaptive fading extended Kalman filter,iTransformer,differential attention mechanism,
abstract: As the core energy storage unit of electric vehicles， precise estimation of the state of charge （SOC） of lithium-ion batteries is crucial to ensure battery performance and enhance energy utilization efficiency. Due to the batteries’ nonlinear electrochemical characteristics and environmental influence， traditional coulomb counting methods suffer from cumulative errors and are significantly affected by external factors. Recursive algorithms improve estimation accuracy but heavily depend on the accuracy of battery models and entail high computational complexity. Meanwhile， machine learning approaches offer strong nonlinear modeling capabilities and generalization advantages but require extensive training time and involve complex parameter tuning. To address the limitation， this paper proposes a lithium-ion battery SOC estimation method based on the improved iTransformer-AFEKF algorithm. This method employs an enhanced differential attention mechanism within the iTransformer for initial SOC prediction， followed by a secondary filtering and correction stage using an adaptive fading extended Kalman filter optimized with adaptive recursive weighted least squares， which effectively suppresses noise interference and dynamically updates model parameters. Validation is conducted under ECE and UDDS driving cycles at three temperatures （0， 25， and 40 °C） using real BMS data. The results demonstrate that the proposed algorithm significantly outperforms the iTransformer-EKF and iTransformer-AFEKF methods in estimation accuracy and generalization ability， achieving reduction in mean absolute error （MAE） and root mean square error （RMSE） by over 20%， with stable error convergence. Across various temperatures and testing conditions， the algorithm achieves a MAE and RMSE of less than 0.80% and 1.14%， respectively. The experiments fully verify the robustness and superiority of the improved iTransformer-AFEKF algorithm under varying conditions and temperatures， providing efficient and accurate SOC estimation support for electric vehicle battery management systems.

title: 基于半监督离群检测的电动车辆动力电池低误报率过温故障诊断方法
title_en: Fault Diagnosis Method for Electric Vehicle Battery Based on Semi-Supervised Stochastic Outlier Selection with Low False Alarm Rate
name: Feng Wu,Zhaosheng Zhang,Liang Li,Xiangyu Wang
keywords: electric vehicle,power battery,fault diagnosis,thermal runaway,
abstract: Battery over-temperature faults can easily trigger local high temperatures and thermal runaway in the battery system of electric vehicles， posing a threat to the lives and property of drivers and passengers. Existing over-temperature fault diagnosis methods have a high false alarm rate for normal batteries， which can cause unnecessary panic among drivers and passengers and cannot accurately guide battery safety warnings and battery module replacement. Therefore， this paper proposes a low false alarm rate over-temperature fault diagnosis method for electric vehicle power batteries based on semi-supervised outlier detection. Firstly， a semi-supervised battery probe temperature outlier detection model is constructed. By fusing the Euclidean distance with the Gaussian adjusted probability density matrix and designing adjustable precision parameters and local entropy， the differences in sparse battery probe temperatures under seasonal and state of charge （SOC） changes are quantified. Secondly， the target function that takes into account of zero false alarm rate and high fault diagnosis rate is defined. A two-step optimization method and a snake strategy are proposed to optimize the model's hyperparameters and internal parameters， forming dynamic thresholds for battery over-temperature faults under different seasons and SOC intervals， achieving accurate diagnosis of battery over-temperature faults. The experimental verification shows that this method can accurately identify over-temperature batteries at least 7 days before vehicle thermal runaway. The precision and accuracy during the entire vehicle life cycle operation is 99.9% and 83.5%， respectively. The maximum false alarm rate of normal batteries under different seasons and SOC is less than 0.3%.

title: 动力电池各向异性导热系数测量与热管理策略研究
title_en: Research on Anisotropic Thermal Conductivity Measurement and Thermal Management Strategies of Power Batteries
name: Hao Tang,Yue Geng,Junfu Qu,Weitao Ye,Xiaona Wang,Qiyue Xu
keywords: power battery,thermal management,thermal conductivity,anisotropy,
abstract: The thermal management system directly affects the performance and lifespan of power batteries. The thermal conductivity， as a critical parameter in thermal management systems， exhibits anisotropic characteristics that significantly influence thermal management strategies. This study proposes a new measurement method that systematically measures the thermal conductivity change of square power lithium batteries in three directions of height， thickness， and length with the temperature and state of charge （SOC）. The error of this method is verified to be less than 1% through finite element simulation and standard material measurement. The results show that the thermal conductivity of the measured square power battery has significant anisotropy， with the height direction of 16.998~17.813 W/（m?K）， the thickness direction of 2.275~2.370 W/（m?K）， and the length direction of 22.165~24.297 W/（m?K）. The temperature and SOC changes have a certain impact on thermal conductivity. A quantitative decision-making model for thermal management strategies based on anisotropic thermal conductivity is constructed using the measured data， providing theoretical basis and engineering guidance for the design and optimization of thermal management systems for power lithium batteries.

title: 基于响应面法的PEMFC引射器多参数耦合优化
title_en: Multi-parameter Coupling Optimization of Ejector for PEMFC by Response Surface Method
name: Pei Fu,Xiaofang Dai,Yongjie Zhang,Zijian Lan,Yisong Chen
keywords: hydrogen ejector,hydrogen recirculation ratio,response surface method,genetic algorithm,coupling optimization,
abstract: In order to address the inefficiency and high time cost of using only Computational Fluid Dynamics （CFD） for optimizing hydrogen ejectors in proton exchange membrane fuel cell （PEMFC） engine systems， this study employs response surface methodology （RSM） combined with a genetic algorithm （GA） to optimize ejector structural parameters and operating pressure. This paper constructs a response surface model using the throat diameter， secondary flow pressure， and outlet pressure as optimization parameters， with the hydrogen recirculation ratio as the response indicator. The analysis of variance shows that the model has significance and good fitting accuracy， and on this basis， it is found that it has excellent adaptability through genetic algorithm optimization. The main conclusions are as follows： （1） The RSM reveals the influence of pressure and throat diameter on the ejection performance. Increasing the secondary flow inlet pressure and outlet pressure can increase the hydrogen recirculation ratio， while the throat diameter and ejection performance show a nonlinear relationship of “M”. （2） Sensitivity analysis shows that the secondary inlet pressure is the dominant factor affecting the performance of the ejector， with a sensitivity of 80.57%. （3） The GA-optimized ejector achieves a 19.42% improvement in hydrogen recirculation ratio from its baseline of 1.77， validating the effectiveness of the coupled algorithm. This conclusion shows the influence of ejector pressure and throat diameter on the hydrogen return ratio in PEMFC engine system， as well as the working mechanism of secondary flow inlet pressure as the dominant factor， which provides an important theoretical basis and practical guidance for optimizing the structure and working parameters of the propeller and improving its fluid regulation performance and hydrogen utilization rate in PEMFC engine system.

title: 电动轻型商用车集成热管理设计与能耗研究
title_en: Integrated Thermal Management Design and Energy Efficiency Research of Battery Electric Light Commercial Vehicles
name: Huiping Fang,Xiaolong Wang,Fan Yuan,Fan Guo
keywords: electric light commercial vehicles,integrated thermal management,energy consumption,road experiments,
abstract: Thermal management technology for electric light commercial vehicles has a significant impact on the driving range and thermal control of the three-electric systems. This paper conducts a functional analysis and component disassembly and integration of the traditional split-type thermal management system， and proposes an integrated thermal management solution suitable for electric light commercial vehicles， which coordinates the heat control relationship of each part and can effectively utilize the residual heat of the motor. The real vehicle tests show that under high-temperature conditions， the system improves the battery cooling effect and temperature uniformity， and shortens the charging time by more than 50%. Under low-temperature conditions， through waste heat recovery and heating optimization， the average energy consumption of the system is reduced by 34.48%， and the driving range is increased by 8.46%. This research provides practical references for the design of thermal management systems of electric commercial vehicles.

title: 双APU混合动力重型车辆智能自适应能量管理策略
title_en: Intelligent Adaptive Energy Management Strategy for Dual-APU Hybrid Heavy-Duty Vehicles
name: Wei Sun,Dongfang Zhang,Yuan Zou,Xudong Zhang,Jun Zhang
keywords: energy management,online update,deep reinforcement learning,Gramian angular field,mutual information,
abstract: For the adaptability issue of energy management strategies for dual-power auxiliary unit （APU） hybrid heavy-duty vehicles under complex operating conditions， this paper proposes an adaptive update mechanism based on dynamic feedback of control strategy performance. This method breaks through the traditional update logic that relies on external condition changes， focusing on internal degradation signals. It accurately triggers updates by calculating mutual information differences through Gramian angular field transformation and introduces an adaptive learning rate to enhance the efficiency of online updates. Additionally， this paper proposes a calculation method for the bus voltage of hybrid heavy-duty vehicles to improve the accuracy of the vehicle model.

title: 越级乘员空间的纯电平台正碰安全仿真开发
title_en: Development of Frontal Collision Safety Simulation of Pure Electric Platform for Overstepping Occupant Space
name: Kai Qiu,Jiechao Pan,Fengli Zhang,Rongrong Zhang,Learn Fei Kong,Li Liu,Ping Du,Haoxiang Wang
keywords: EDTW,DOE matrix,target definition,section design method,equivalent model,
