The results show that compared to single crystal lattice materials， polycrystal lattice materials significantly improve specific energy absorption （SEA） at the same lattice angle， especially with 143% increase at the lattice angle of 30°. The crashworthiness of polycrystal lattice materials is influenced by grain size， intragranular lattice angle， and grain randomness. When grain size decreases， the energy absorption process becomes smoother， but excessively small grains may exacerbate fluctuations in the energy absorption process due to boundary effect. Polycrystal lattice materials with a 45° lattice angle and random lattice angles of 30°/60° exhibit stable energy absorption processes， and those with higher randomness in grain orientations show an even smoother energy absorption process. The novel polycrystal lattice mechanical metamaterials proposed in this paper can effectively enhance the crashworthiness of traditional lattice materials and provide guidance for the design and optimization of new lightweight lattice metamaterials.

title: 基于机器学习的变形模式控制耐撞性优化
title_en: Machine Learning Based Crashworthiness Optimization with Structural Deformation Mode Control
name: Zhixiang Li,Danhui Zhu,Jiahuan Zhang
keywords: structural optimization,machine learning,image clustering,crashworthiness,
abstract: Crashworthiness optimization is an effective way to achieve better passive safety protection performance of vehicles， but current optimization focuses on improving numerical response， while neglecting the control of a category response， namely， deformation modes. The deformation mode of key components is related to the effectiveness of vehicle force transmission path design. If an unsatisfactory deformation mode occurs in the optimization solution， the effectiveness of the optimization result cannot be guaranteed. Therefore， in this study a machine learning based deformation mode control optimization method is proposed to improve the crashworthiness index while ensuring that all samples in the optimization solution deform in ideal modes. Structural deformation is represented in the form of images， and deep learning auto encoder is used to extract deformation features and cluster them to identify different deformation modes. Then， machine learning prediction models based on Light Gradient Boosting Machine （LightGBM） are established for the identified deformation modes and numerical responses. Finally， the optimization is solved based on the machine learning prediction models. The proposed machine learning optimization method is validated using a full vehicle frontal collision case， and the results show that while improving the numerical crashworthiness responses， the deformation mode of the longitudinal beam is ensured to deform in an ideal mode. This study demonstrates the prospects of machine learning in improving the effectiveness of structural optimization.

title: 基于兰姆波的CFRP电池箱冲击损伤评估
title_en: Impact Damage Assessment of CFRP Battery Box Based on Lamb Waves
name: Zhongyu Li,Zitong He,Jianfeng Wang,Bing Wang,Yiqun Liu,Junyuan Zhang
keywords: battery box,lightweight,composites,impact damage,Lamb waves,
abstract: Lamb waves， with the characteristics of long propagation distance， low cost， and good sensitivity to various damages， offer significant potential for studying the visually undetectable damage caused by low-velocity impact in carbon fiber reinforced polymer （CFRP） battery box. Although relative acoustic nonlinear parameters （RANP） have been shown to be effective in quantifying the degree of impact damage to composite materials， the mechanism by which damage affects them has not been explored. In this study， a combination of experimental and simulation method is used to study for the first time the effect of different impact damages on the propagation of Lamb waves in CFRP battery boxes. To this end， a geometric model of the battery box structure is first established. Then， impact tests are carried out on CFRP， and a simulation model for damage monitoring of CFRP battery boxes is built. Finally， the effect of delamination， matrix compression damage， and fiber tensile damage on the damage assessment parameters of CFRP battery boxes is studied. The results indicate that the established CFRP simulation model is reliable in calculation accuracy， with the RANP parameter being sensitive to the damage area of each mode， though not to the damage position in the thickness direction. Damage causes the Lamb wave to generate new frequency components during propagation. The calculation of the RANP parameter can thus analyze the degree of damage. When the degree of damage is low， the size of the RANP parameter depends more on the interlayer shedding damage， and once the damage exceeds a certain threshold， the size of the RANP parameter depends more on the intralayer damage such as the fiber damage of the CFRP. The research results have important guiding value for the structural-functional integrated design of automobile collision safety components.

title: 后倾乘员碰撞损伤与防护研究综述
title_en: A Review of Reclined Occupant Crash Injuries and Impact Protection
name: Wenxuan Shen,Rui Dai,Puyuan Tan,Qing Zhou
keywords: intelligent vehicles,zero-gravity seat,reclined occupant,impact injuries,crash protection means,
abstract: With the development of intelligent vehicles and autonomous driving technologies， zero-gravity seat， with occupant comfort as core function， has been equipped in some vehicles. Compared to upright seating， reclined occupants face a higher risk of injury in collision， making the development of crash safety solutions imminent. In this paper， a review of the current research status and development trends regarding the crash safety of reclined occupants is conducted， focusing on injury mechanism， restraint systems， and research tools. The findings are summarized as follows： （1） Injury patterns for reclined occupants differ from those for upright occupants， and the injury mechanism at typical sites such as the lumbar spine and the iliac crest have not been fully clarified. （2） Traditional restraint systems with three-point seat belts as the core， even after improvement and optimization， is still difficult to provide effective overall protection for reclined occupants. Development of new protective means that can reasonably balance submarine and spinal injuries under the integrated active-passive safety system is a key issue in crash protection research for reclined occupants. （3） Crash dummies and human body models （HBMs）， as the primary research and evaluation tools， need to improve their usability and bio-fidelity for reclined conditions.

title: 车载雷达关键场景的数据采集与标记方法
title_en: Data Collection and Annotation Method for Radar on Some Key Scenarios
name: Kaibo Huang,Weiwen Deng,Ying Wang,Rui Zhao,Juan Ding
keywords: autonomous driving,millimeter-wave radar,false alarm,missed alarm,object labeling,
abstract: False alarm and missed alarm of automotive radar are key factors affecting the safety and reliability of autonomous driving systems， thus requiring a large amount of labeled test data for targeted research. However， the occurrence probability of false alarm and missed alarm is low， and the unstable status of radar targets makes it difficult to label them. Therefore， in this paper， firstly efficient test schemes are designed to obtain key radar data based on the generation mechanism of radar false alarm and missed alarm. Then， by constructing a correlation function to quantify the correlation between radar targets and scene targets and using genetic algorithms to optimize this function， an automatic labeling method for radar targets is established. Finally， the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified through real data acquisition. The experimental results show that the proposed method can efficiently obtain crucial false alarm and missed alarm data. The labeling method in this paper can accurately identify radar targets corresponding to scene targets and distinguish between false alarm and real targets.

title: 交通信号与网联汽车速度协同优化方法研究
title_en: Research on Cooperative Optimization Method of Traffic Signal and Speed of Connected Vehicles
name: Xinyu Chen,Jian Chen,Lijun Qian,Qidong Wang
keywords: intelligent transportation,signalized intersections,cooperative control,human driver error,
abstract: In order to improve the traffic efficiency at the signalized intersections and the fuel economy of vehicles， a cooperative optimization method of traffic signals and speed of connected vehicles considering the human driver error is proposed in this paper. In the traffic layer， by transforming the traffic signal optimization problem into a sequencing problem to find the optimal sequence of vehicles passing through the intersections， the optimal control model for traffic signal optimization is constructed and a traffic signal optimization algorithm based on dynamic planning is proposed. In the vehicle layer， the optimal control model for vehicle speed optimization is constructed by considering the influence of driver error， and a speed optimization algorithm based on fast stochastic model predictive control for connected vehicles is proposed. The simulation and intelligent connected micro-vehicle test results show that the co-optimization strategy proposed in this paper can effectively alleviate the deceleration and stopping of vehicles at intersections due to driver errors， and further reduce the travel time， idling time and fuel consumption of vehicles.

title: 基于点云时空特征补偿网络的智能网联车辆协同感知
title_en: Collaborative Perception Based on Point Cloud Spatio-Temporal Feature Compensation Network for Intelligent Connected Vehicles
name: Mingfang Zhang,Ying Liu,Jian Ma,Ye He,Li Wang
keywords: intelligent connected vehicles,collaborative perception,spatio-temporal feature compensation,point cloud,feature fusion,
abstract: In order to overcome the influence of network latency on the cooperative perception accuracy and simultaneously improve the point cloud feature expression capability， a cooperative perception method based on point cloud spatio-temporal feature compensation network for intelligent connected vehicles is proposed. Firstly， the point-to-pillar feature extraction method is used to process the raw point cloud data， and the local neighborhood features of the laser points are then spliced with pillar feature maps. Secondly， the temporal latency compensation module based on the PredRNN algorithm is designed to predict the point cloud features of historical frames received from the surrounding connected vehicles， so as to achieve the synchronization of point cloud features from two vehicles. Thirdly， the spatial feature fusion compensation module is utilized to aggregate the inter-vehicle point cloud features， and multi-resolution features are fused through the bidirectional multi-scale feature pyramid network. The output includes vehicle target geometry size， heading angle and other information. Finally， the test results on the V2V4real dataset and the self-collected dataset demonstrate that the detection accuracy of the proposed method is superior to classical cooperative perception algorithms. Furthermore， it exhibits good adaptability to various latency cases and the inference process meets the real-time requirements.

title: SFW-YOLOv8复杂场景视频车辆检测模型
title_en: SFW-YOLOv8 Complex Scene Video Vehicle Detection Model
name: Qin Zhu,Shenyang Han,Mingru Zeng,Pinghong Lai,Chuimao Wu,Weiyi Hu
keywords: vehicle target detection,spatio-temporal feature fusion,Transformer,YOLOv8,attention mechanism,
abstract: For the problem that it is difficult for video vehicle detection models to extract rich target features in complex traffic monitoring scenarios， in this paper a new spatial-temporal feature fusion module SF-Module is established from the perspective of making full use of spatial-temporal feature information of video images. The multi-head self-attention mechanism in Transformer model is used to extract and fuse the temporal and spatial feature information of current and historical frames of video vehicle images to enrich the feature information of the target. On this basis， based on YOLOv8 network， the newly created spatio-temporal feature fusion module SF-Module is integrated in its neck network to mine spatio-temporal feature information of video image sequences. At the same time， the WIoU loss function is introduced as the prediction frame regression loss to reduce the harmful gradient generated by the low quality label frame， and the SFW-YOLOv8 video vehicle detection model is designed. Finally， the newly established SFW-YOLOv8 complex scene video vehicle detection model is tested on the UA-DETRAC dataset， and some images in the dataset are simulated to enhance the data on rainy and foggy days， so as to improve the generalization of the vehicle detection model. The experimental results show that the values of mAP50 and mAP50：5：95 of the SFW-YOLOv8 video vehicle detection model are 79.1% and 63.6%， which are 1.7% and 3.3% higher than that of the YOLOv8 model， respectively. The reasoning speed is 11 ms/ frame， which has excellent detection performance.

title: 车用燃料电池堆变负载电流下的出入口温度控制研究
title_en: Research on the Inlet and Outlet Temperature Control of Vehicle Fuel Cell Stacks Under Variable Loading Currents
name: Yisong Chen,Zijian Lan,Xu Cai,Ziqiang Cao,Qingshan Liu,Pei Fu
keywords: overall model of PEMFC,temperature control,PID,PSO-PID,dynamic change PSO-PID,output power,
abstract: To solve the problem of large fluctuation of inlet and outlet temperature on vehicle proton exchange membrane fuel cell （PEMFC） under variable loading currents， a dynamic change particle swarm optimization （PSO）—proportional integral derivative （PID） algorithm is proposed. Firstly， the overall simulation model of the PEMFC engine system with rated power of 150 kW is built. Based on existing references， the accuracy of the output power and voltage of the model is validated； and according to the validated results， the supply of reactant gas is set following demand on currents， which reflects real working conditions of the PEMFC engine system. Based on the model built and the control strategy that the mass flow rate of cooling water following output power， PID， PSO-PID and dynamic change PSO-PID are used on the mass flow rate of cooling air from radiating fans to conduct research on the control effect of them on the inlet and outlet temperature and output power of FCs under variable loading currents. The results show that compared with PID， under PSO-PID and dynamic change PSO-PID， the transient overshoots decreasing amplitudes of inlet temperature of FCs are both 13.7%， those of outlet temperature both 36.0% and the output power reaching the stable condition faster. The time when dynamic change PSO-PID reaching the optimum values only accounts for 57.1% of that under PSO-PID， which can reduce more unnecessary computation and input the PID parameters into the stack temperature controller ahead of PSO-PID. The dynamic PSO-PID algorithm can be used on actual inlet and outlet temperature control of FCs more efficiently and faster， contributing to improving the stability of the temperature and the output power of vehicle PEMFC.

title: 融合交通信息的燃料电池汽车能量管理研究进展
title_en: Research Progress on Traffic Information-Integrated Energy Management for Fuel Cell Vehicles
name: Yaxiong Wang,Yiying Fan,Kai Ou,Zhongbao Wei,Jiujun Zhang
keywords: fuel cell vehicle,energy management,traffic information,predictive method,
abstract: Energy management determines the power distribution of the power system of fuel cell vehicles （FCVs） and affects the economy and durability of FCVs. As the operating conditions of vehicles are complex and variable， energy management can improve the output performance of FCV power system by integrating traffic information. In this paper， the optimization objectives of FCV energy management are summarized， and the traditional rule-based and optimization-based energy management strategies are analyzed. Then， focusing on the analysis and prediction of traffic information such as vehicle speed and traffic condition， prediction methods such as Markov method and artificial intelligence are reviewed， and the research progress of FCV energy management strategies by integrating traffic information is summarized. Finally， the research direction of development of FCV energy management by integrating traffic information is proposed.

title: 考虑动态多目标需求的车辆横摆稳定性自适应控制策略
title_en: Adaptive Control Strategy for Vehicle Yaw Stability Considering Dynamic Multi-objective Requirements
name: Jian Wu,Hanlin Wang,Bing Zhu,Jian Zhao,Zhicheng Chen
keywords: vehicle engineering,stability adaptive control,multi-objective requirements,dynamic stability region,model predictive control,
abstract: For the dynamic multi-objective requirements of yaw maneuverability and lateral stability under different driving states， an adaptive control strategy for vehicle yaw stability is proposed. Firstly， the vehicle dynamics model is established by piecewise linear fitting technology， and the dynamic stability region boundary related to road adhesion and longitudinal velocity is obtained in phase plane by integrated application of improved two-line method and fuzzy theory. Then， the stability risk during vehicle driving is quantitatively characterized and the dynamic multi-objective mapping function is introduced to adjust the built-in parameters of the stability control strategy designed based on the model predictive theory so as to match the dynamic multi-objective demand of vehicle lateral stability， yaw maneuverability and actuator energy consumption. Finally， the simulation test results prove that the designed control strategy can help the vehicle obtain safer and better stability control effect than the traditional method under various conditions.

title: 变截面空心矩形前轴的设计及垂向、纵向工况性能的研究
title_en: Research on Design of Hollow Rectangular Front Axle with Variable Cross-section and Vertical and Longitudinal Performance Under Working Conditions
name: Liandong Wang,Jinyu Li,Kai Feng,Yu Zhang,Ye Tian
keywords: hollow rectangular front axle,design method,strength stiffness,fatigue life,bench test,
abstract: The front axle manufactured through forging has large dimension， and the stress on it is complex. It is difficult to lightweight due to the limitation of the I-beam structure. In this paper， the design method of hollow front axle is given， and the hollow rectangular structure with variable cross-section and wall thickness and a combination of leaf spring seats are used to achieve lightweight and improve bending and torsion resistance. The influence of wall thickness at the kingpin hole on the strength of the fist is revealed， and the appropriate wall thickness range of the fist and the height and width coefficient of the plugging hole is given， by the vertical and longitudinal working conditions of the finite element mode. The 1：1 hollow front axle sample with an axle load of 5 t is produced by using seamless steel pipes， which is 10.75% lighter than the forged front axle. The variation law of vertical displacement and axial stress changes on the lower surface of the shaft and the stress distribution at the edge of the sealing hole on the outer end face of the fist are revealed through stiffness tests under vertical and longitudinal working conditions， as well as static strength and fatigue life tests under vertical working condition. The results show that the stiffness and static strength of the variable cross-section hollow rectangular front shaft meet industry standards， and the fatigue life under vertical working condition is much higher than industry standards. It is indicated that the variable cross-section hollow front axle can improve performance and achieve lightweight.

title: 智能网联汽车区域式48 V电气架构关键技术综述
title_en: A Review on Key Technology of Zonal 48 V Electrical Architecture for Intelligent Connected Vehicles
name: Li Wei,Bin Guo,Xinling Zhou,Haiquan Liang
keywords: zonal 48 V electrical architecture,functional safety,predictive energy management,potential fault diagnosis,electronic fuse,
abstract: With the continuous advancement of intelligence level， by-wire technology， and comfort feature in intelligent connected vehicles， the traditional 12 V electrical architecture can no longer meet the high-power， high-reliability， and software-defined requirements. This paper systematically reviews the current research progress on zonal 48 V electrical architecture for intelligent connected vehicles， focusing on four aspects： architectural evolution， key technology， component design， and overall development process. Finally， prospects for future development direction are presented， which provides theoretical references for related research.

title: 边缘计算环境下ICV队列的任务卸载与资源分配
title_en: Task Offloading and Resource Allocation for ICV Platoon Under Edge Computing
name: Jiahui Liu,Yuan Zou,Jinming Wu,Guodong Du,Wenjing Sun
keywords: vehicle platoon,mobile edge computing,task offloading,resource allocation,deep reinforcement learning,
abstract: With the rapid advancement of Intelligent Connected Vehicles （ICV） and vehicle to infrastructure （V2I） technologies， in vehicle application increasingly demand greater computational capacity and lower response latency. Although Mobile Edge Computing （MEC） can alleviate these requirements by offloading tasks to edge servers， its limited coverage and constrained resources struggle to meet high-density workloads. Vehicle platoon provides an effective solution by leveraging stable inter vehicular communication and shared computational resources. In this paper， for a MEC-assisted edge computing system for ICV platoon， an optimization model to minimize the comprehensive task execution cost is constructed and a two stage Task Offloading and Resource Allocation algorithm （TS-TORA） is proposed. Based on the system’s “offload-then-execute” process， the algorithm decomposes the task offloading and resource allocation into two levels of optimization problems and heterogeneous scheduling strategies are designed according to the node type. In the task offloading stage， the platoon leader （PL） employs Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimization （MAPPO） to generate a global offloading strategy； in the resource allocation stage， platoon vehicles （PVs） apply a priority-based greedy algorithm for local resource allocation， while MEC servers leverage a Double Deep Q-Network （DDQN） for dynamic multi-task scheduling， thus balancing global scheduling efficiency and node execution flexibility. The simulation results show that TS-TORA consistently outperforms benchmark algorithms across varying platoon sizes， task complexities， and latency constraints. Specifically， task success rates reach 97.06%， 84.62%， and 78.31% for platoons of 4， 6， and 8 PVs， respectively. Moreover， the average cost decreases with increasing platoon size， demonstrating the algorithm’s adaptability and scalability.

title: 基于改进人类反馈强化学习的端到端自动驾驶决策模型
title_en: End-To-End Autonomous Driving Decision Model Based on Improved Human Feedback Reinforcement Learning
name: Wuhong Cao,Yingfeng Cai,Ze Liu,Qingchao Liu,Hai Wang,Long Chen,Xiaodong Zhang
keywords: end-to-end autonomous driving,human feedback reinforcement learning,response ratio,diffusion model,
abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving is the latest research hotspot in the field of intelligent vehicles. Most existing methods use manually designed reinforcement learning （RL） reward functions， which suffer from limitation in learning efficiency and generalization in complex driving environment. To address these issues， in this paper an end-to-end autonomous driving model based on improved human feedback reinforcement learning is proposed. Firstly， an automated reward feedback system that simplifies human preferences using response ratio estimation method is constructed， improving the logical consistency of driving strategies while reducing manual design cost. Secondly， an optimization method for pre-training the reward function accelerates convergence by embedding prior knowledge early in learning. Lastly， a novel data augmentation technique based on diffusion models is proposed and a dynamic-enhanced reward replacement mechanism is established， addressing reward overfitting and transition smoothness issues， thus improving agent adaptability and robustness in complex scenarios. The method is validated using the CARLA simulator， achieving a driving score of 87±2 on the LeaderBoard benchmark， demonstrating better generalization and learning efficiency compared to existing approaches.

title: 基于代价地图的非结构化道路参考线生成算法
title_en: Unstructured Road Reference Line Generation Algorithm Based on Cost Map
name: Jiedong Sun,Xudong Zhang,Shuo Zhang,Mingan Zhao,Shuo Hu,Shujie Zhang,Yuan Zou,Jing He
keywords: path planning,grid-based cost map,Astar algorithm,motion primitives,quadratic programming,
abstract: A multi-layer cost map model based on grid-based cost mapping is proposed in this paper to address the challenges of unstructured roads characterized by undulating terrain， uneven surfaces， and the absence of distinct boundary markers， which integrates slope cost， roughness cost， and boundary cost. A multi-stage algorithmic framework of search-optimization-sampling-optimization is designed： initial paths are generated and smoothed in grid maps through an enhanced Astar algorithm， followed by the generation of motion primitive sample sets in the Frenet coordinate system. Smooth global reference paths compliant with vehicle kinematics are produced via a two-layer optimization mechanism that combines dynamic programming and quadratic programming. The real vehicle experiments show that the proposed method can plan smooth global paths in unstructured road environment that satisfy kinematic constraints， exhibiting excellent ride comfort while fully complying with vehicle kinematic requirements.

title: 状态自适应更新的激光雷达-惯性里程计
title_en: State-Adaptive Update LiDAR-Inertial Odometry
name: Yubin Ling,Zhiguo Zhao,Danshu Yan,Chuanfu Shen
keywords: LiDAR-inertial odometry,iterated error-state Kalman filter,feature extraction,state-adaptive update,
abstract: Under high-speed and aggressive motion conditions， current LiDAR-Inertial Odometry （LIO） systems experience rapid accumulation of IMU forward propagation errors， resulting in deteriorated motion distortion compensation accuracy. This initiates a cascading chain of "compensation error - registration error - state estimation error，" ultimately causing significant deviation of vehicle trajectory from ground truth. Therefore， a State-Adaptive Update LiDAR-Inertial Odometry （SAU-LIO） system based on the Iterated Error-State Kalman Filter （IESKF） is proposed in this paper. Firstly， a covariance eigenvalue threshold-based dynamic adjustment strategy is proposed to monitor real-time LIO error accumulation trends and adaptively reduce state update intervals， effectively suppressing error divergence during aggressive motion. Secondly， based on a unified line-plane feature extraction approach a probabilistic observation model is constructed， enabling optimal weighted fusion of features with varying confidence levels through observation covariance matrix constraints， thereby maximizing environmental feature utilization. Finally， test results based on University of Michigan North Campus Long-Term Vision and LIDAR Dataset （NCLT） and EU Long-term Dataset with Multiple Sensors for Autonomous Driving （UTBM）， supplemented by real-vehicle field tests， show that SAU-LIO maintains real-time computational efficiency while achieving superior localization accuracy compared to state-of-the-art methods. Under low-speed working conditions， the average positioning error is reduced by 14.3% compared with the suboptimal comparison algorithm. Under combined working conditions， the average positioning error is reduced by 9.4% compared with the suboptimal comparison algorithm.

title: 基于车辆动力学的激光雷达点云失真校正方法
title_en: Vehicle Dynamics Based Distortion Correction of LiDAR Point Cloud
name: Jian Zhao,Zhidong Lin,Jing Zhang,Linhui Li,Pengbo Liu,Nana Lü
keywords: road vibration,point cloud distortion,perception model,IMU,target detection,
abstract: LiDAR is one of the important sensors in the automatic driving perception system. When the vehicle is driving on the bumpy road， LiDAR is affected by the vibration and in the point cloud imaging will produce centimetre-level aberration distortion， which seriously affects the environment perception accuracy and efficiency. For this reason， in this paper a LiDAR point cloud correction method considering the influence of vehicle dynamics is proposed， using inertial measurement units to measure real-time vehicle position and state data， establishing a LiDAR accurate point cloud imaging sensing model for bumpy roads， and combining with image visualisation to compare the point cloud vibration offset and correct the point cloud imaging effect. The simulation results at 30 km/h speed on bumpy road from class C to class F show that the maximum Hausdorff distance of the proposed correction method is 3.503 m， which is 23.75% lower than that of the no-correction method； the target detection mAP of the proposed correction method can be increased by 30.50% compared with that of the no-correction method， and the fastest detection speed is 56 FPS.

title: 基于CLOSI的车载斜视FMCW SAR子孔径改进Omega-K成像算法
title_en: A Modified Omega-K Imaging Algorithm Based on CLOSI for Squinted Automotive FMCW SAR with Sub-Aperture
name: Letian Zeng,Sheng Zhang,Qi Mao,Jingzhao Li,Yunhuai Zou
keywords: automotive frequency-modulated continuous-wave synthetic aperture radar （FMCW SAR）,squinted,sub-aperture,cross-line-of-sight interpolation （CLOSI）,phase-wave-number variation ratio,Deramp processing,
abstract: Due to the short duration of automotive frequency-modulated continuous-wave （FMCW） synthetic aperture radar （SAR）， targets located at the edge of the imaging scene are often distorted in the SAR image， rendering conventional imaging algorithms ineffective. Moreover， the under-utilization of the supported area in the wave-number domain significantly compromises image quality. To address these challenges， a modified Omega-K imaging algorithm based on cross-line-of-sight interpolation （CLOSI） is proposed for the squinted automotive FMCW SAR with sub-aperture in this paper. CLOSI ensures the optimal utilization of the wave-number spectrum， thereby guaranteeing superior image quality. By compensating for the phase-wave-number variation ratio， the need for zero padding is eliminated， thereby enhancing processing efficiency. Integration with Deramp processing enables the final imaging results to be focused in both the range position and azimuth wave-number domains， which solves the problem of point target position aliasing arising from the azimuth width of the imaging scene exceeding the length of the synthetic aperture. Finally， the feasibility of the proposed algorithm is verified by point target simulation experiments.

title: 基于BEV特征融合的3D目标检测方法
title_en: 3D Object Detection Method Based on BEV Feature Fusion
name: Jiang Cao,Yulin Han,Dafang Wang,Wenshuo Zhao,Yifei Zhao,Qinzhong Hou
keywords: autonomous driving perception,3D object detection,multi-sensor fusion,BEV perspective,
abstract: Autonomous vehicles have developed rapidly in recent years. Driving safety is the most important factor for autonomous vehicles， and the safety requires good perception algorithms to ensure it. The existing technical route usually chooses the BEV perspective to fuse features from different sensors， but the fusion network used in the existing research is relatively simple. Therefore， in this paper s a feature fusion network is designed to fuse BEV features from multi-sensor and multi-modality to alleviate the problem of spatial misalignment between BEV features， enhance BEV features， and improve the accuracy of 3D object detection. Considering the insufficient progress of depth prediction of image data， in this paper an image depth supervision network is also designed， which uses point clouds to generate Gaussian depth maps to directly supervise the training process of the depth prediction network. The experimental results show that the mAP and NDS of the network on nuScenes reaches 0.669 and 0.698 respectively. The image depth predicted by this method is more continuous and the depth jump is reduced， with the edge information of BEV features clearer and the features with potential target more significant.

title: 基于图像增强与Transformer网络的异常光照场景路面附着系数估计方法
title_en: Road Adhesion Coefficient Estimation Method in Abnormal Lighting Scenes Based on Image Enhancement and Transformer Network
name: Yuan Guo,Yingfeng Cai,Hai Wang,Xiaoqiang Sun,Yicheng Li,Long Chen
keywords: road adhesion coefficient,semantic segmentation,image enhancement,image classification,
abstract: The road adhesion coefficient is a key parameter of the vehicle's active safety control system. Its accurate and fast real-time estimation is of great significance for improving driving safety. For the problem of estimating the road adhesion coefficient under abnormal lighting scenes， in this paper a deep learning classification model is proposed combined with image enhancement， which effectively overcomes the influence of lighting changes and weather factors on visual perception， and innovatively introduces confidence and weight factors to combine weighted time series information fusion， and finally obtains the road adhesion coefficient estimation result with spatiotemporal consistency. The experimental results show that the average classification accuracy of the proposed estimation method for the four road adhesion levels is as high as 98.33%. In the actual vehicle deployment and actual vehicle road verification， it is found that the proposed scheme reduces the standard deviation of the estimated result fluctuation to 0.05 under abnormal conditions such as sudden changes in lighting， rainy and foggy weather， etc.， which provides a reliable guarantee for the safe decision-making of the intelligent driving system in abnormal lighting scenes.

title: 氢直喷发动机非典型早燃特征与分类研究
title_en: Characteristics and Classification of Atypical Pre-Ignition Phenomenon in Hydrogen Direct Injection Engines
name: Zhendong Liang,Fangxi Xie,Dingchao Qian,Mingli Liu,Xiaoping Li,Beiping Jiang
keywords: hydrogen direct injection engine,pre-ignition phenomenon,machine learning,prediction and classification,hyperparameter optimization,
abstract: Hydrogen direct injection （HDI） engines may exhibit a specific type of pre-ignition during the early and mid-stages of the compression stroke （PEMC）. This phenomenon significantly affects engine stability and limits the potential of hydrogen fuel utilization. Therefore， accurate identification of PEMC events is essential to ensure stable combustion and safe operation of HDI engines. In this study， classification models are developed and evaluated based on experimental data， combining five mainstream machine learning algorithms—artificial neural networks （ANN）， extreme gradient boosting （XGBoost）， support vector machines （SVM）， k-nearest neighbors （k-NN）， and random forests （RF）—with five commonly used hyperparameter optimization methods： random search （RS）， grid search （GS）， Bayesian optimization （BO）， genetic algorithm （GA）， and particle swarm optimization （PSO）. The results show that all models achieve a minimum classification accuracy of 0.899 1， indicating strong discrimination capability. Among them， RS-XGBoost， PSO-XGBoost， and GA-k-NN perform relatively better， with training/testing accuracies of 0.979 3/0.959 3， 0.982 9/0.947 4， and 0.983 0/0.942 9， respectively. This study provides methodological reference for the future development and control optimization of HDI engines.

title: 基于部分充电电压特征的锂电池SOH估计方法
title_en: SOH Estimation Method for Lithium-ion Battery Based on Partial Charging Voltage Characterization
name: Shan Li,Jian Ma,Xuan Zhao,Kai Zhang,Zhipeng Jiao
keywords: lithium-ion battery,charging voltage,SOH estimation,COA,LSTM,
abstract: Accurately estimating the State of Health （SOH） of lithium-ion batteries is an important guarantee for the safe and efficient operation of new energy vehicles， and it is of great significance for the estimation of battery charging state and remaining service life. For the low accuracy of SOH estimation of lithium-ion batteries， in this paper a hybrid deep learning estimation model of SOH of lithium batteries based on charging voltage features is proposed. Firstly， based on the charging voltage segments， a few features related to the sensor measurement parameters and their indirect calculation are extracted， and four key feature parameters closely related to the state of health are screened out as input to the model. Secondly， a convolutional neural network-long and short-term memory neural network （CNN-LSTM） hybrid model is constructed， and the model hyperparameters are further optimized based on the coati optimization algorithm （COA） to enhance the accuracy and robustness of the estimation model. The SOH estimation model is validated at multiple levels from single unit and whole vehicle， and compared with the three estimation models of Gray Wolf Optimization Algorithm （GWO）-CNN-LSTM， Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm （PSO）-CNN-LSTM， CNN-LSTM， and CNN-LSTM， and the COA-CNN-LSTM estimation model is the most optimal in terms of precision and accuracy， and its root mean square error， average absolute error， and average absolute percentage error are all within 0.80%， 0.73% and 0.84%， which verifies the applicability and accuracy of the constructed estimation model in batteries with different capacities， different aging path and different chemical systems. The COA-CNN-LSTM hybrid deep learning model constructed in this paper can better characterize the battery performance decline based on the combination of indirect health feature parameters and direct feature parameters， and the model can still have high estimation accuracy when SOH estimation is performed by using the health feature parameters obtained from partial charging voltage segments.

title: 基于策略可靠性评估的燃料电池汽车DRL-ECMS能量管理方法研究
title_en: Research on DRL-ECMS Energy Management Method for Fuel Cell Vehicle Based on Policy Reliability Assessment
name: Ruchen Huang,Hongwen He,Qicong Su,Li Kang
keywords: deep reinforcement learning,equivalent consumption minimization strategy,energy management,reliability assessment mechanism,ensemble network model,
abstract: Deep reinforcement learning-based energy management strategies （EMSs） often suffer from reduced reliability and lack of interpretability under unfamiliar driving conditions， which can negatively impact optimization performance. To address this issue， taking fuel cell vehicles as the research object， an energy management method based on policy reliability assessment is proposed. An offline training framework that integrates intelligent learning with model-based optimization is developed， where the soft actor-critic （SAC） algorithm is employed to dynamically determine the optimal equivalent factor for the equivalent consumption minimization strategy （ECMS）. A policy reliability assessment mechanism is designed， utilizing an ensemble policy network model to quantitatively evaluate the reliability of EMS decisions. Besides， based on the predefined reliability thresholds， the equivalent factor is corrected online to ensure the interpretability of safety-critical action. The experimental simulation results show that compared to standard SAC and conventional adaptive ECMS， the proposed SAC-ECMS training framework improves fuel economy by 4.32% and 7.82%， respectively. Under unfamiliar test cycles， the reliability assessment mechanism further enhances fuel economy by 2.87% while demonstrating real-time computational performance.

title: 燃料电池系统多尺度综合建模及能效协同优化研究
title_en: Multiscale Integrated Modeling and Energy Efficiency Collaborative Optimization of Fuel Cell Systems
name: Youwei Xu,Fan Zhang,Yiqiang Pei
keywords: fuel cell systems,multivariable joint virtual calibration,multiscale integrated model,genetic algorithm,energy efficiency collaborative optimization,
abstract: Fuel cell systems are complex energy conversion systems involving multiphysics coupling. The joint optimization of net output power and system efficiency is critical for improving performance and reducing energy consumption. In this paper， a high precision component model is constructed using a multivariable joint virtual calibration technique. A multiscale integrated model of a 160 kW fuel cell system is developed and applied to simulate and validate key parameters， including voltage， gas supply pressure and flow rate， and thermal management temperature under dynamic operating conditions. The model achieves an overall accuracy of 97.86%. Furthermore， a genetic algorithm-based collaborative optimization strategy is employed with the objective of maximizing system efficiency to conduct optimization calculation at four typical net output power levels of 130 kW， 140 kW， 150 kW， and 160 kW， by considering the constraints of key operating parameters. The results show that the system efficiency at the above output power levels is 43.1%， 41.9%， 38.4%， and 36.8%， respectively. Additionally， the specific operating parameters of each component are obtained， achieving a synergistic optimization of net output power and system efficiency， which provides theoretical guidance and engineering references for the design， development， and operational optimization of fuel cell systems.

title: 基于VSD-MPC的主动悬架预瞄控制策略
title_en: Preview Control Strategy for Active Suspension Based on VSD-MPC
name: Jian Zhao,Wenbo Zhou,Yue Wang,Bing Zhu,Zhicheng Chen,Jiayi Han,Peixing Zhang,Dongjian Song
keywords: automotive engineering,active suspension,preview control,vehicle speed adaptive,model predictive control,
abstract: For the problem of poor adaptation to vehicle speed of the active suspension preview control strategy， a variable speed discrete-model predictive control （VSD-MPC） method based active suspension preview control strategy is proposed. Firstly， a vehicle speed adaptive pavement elevation information sampling mechanism is designed by the time-domain conversion method to match the requirements of active suspension for pavement information. Secondly， the VSD-MPC method is proposed for active suspension preview control. By employing the Laguerre function， the process of solving the optimal control sequence via quadratic programming in traditional MPC is replaced by the fitting and differentiation step which reduces computational cost. The simulation results indicate that the proposed active suspension preview control strategy can not only improves the vertical performance of vehicles by at least 39.4% at different vehicle speed， but also reduces computational cost by more than 50%.

title: 基于驱-制-转协同控制的多轴分布式特种车辆操纵稳定性控制技术
title_en: Handling Stability Control Technology for Multi-axle Distributed-Drive Special Vehicles Based on Driving-Braking-Steering Coordinated Control
name: Hongjie Cheng,Zhenwei Hou,Zhihao Liu,Jianhua Li,Yuan Zhao,Xiuyu Liu
keywords: distributed drive,multi-axle special vehicle,model predictive control,active all-wheel steering,direct yaw moment control,yaw stability,
abstract: To solve the problem of high drive power demand in heavy-duty maneuver and handling stability control of multi-axle distributed drive special vehicles， in this paper a hierarchical stability control architecture integrating multivariate cooperative control and drive-brake-steer decoupling control is proposed， achieving handling stability control while reducing in-wheel motor power requirements. For the problem of uneven multi-control allocation caused by traditional model prediction， fuzzy control is introduced to dynamically adjust model control weight. With vehicle yaw rate and sideslip angle as state variables， additional yaw moment and active steering angles of 2nd-5th axle wheels as control input， a PID longitudinal speed controller is additionally designed. The lower-level controller allocates upper-level calculated additional yaw moment， longitudinal forces， and active steering angles by minimizing the tire load rate objective function. A TruckSim/Simulink co-simulation environment is constructed to validate the proposed method under high adhesion coefficient road double-lane-change and steering angle step conditions. The results show that compared with traditional additional yaw moment control and active rear steering control， the proposed controller reduces yaw rate by 32.12% and 18.25%， decreases sideslip angle peaks by 94.66% and 91.38%， and reduces maximum single in-wheel motor torque demand by 88.04% and 82.41% respectively in double-lane-change condition （v=70 km/h， μ=0.85）. Under steering angle step condition （v=70 km/h， μ=0.85）， sideslip angle peaks decrease by 94.87% and 94.74%， while maximum single in-wheel motor torque demand reduces by 74.94% and 70.87% respectively compared with traditional methods.

title: 基于分层优化的混合动力客车模式切换过程动态协调控制
title_en: Dynamic Coordination Control of Hybrid Bus Mode Switching Process Based on Hierarchical Optimization
name: Dafeng Song,Delong Yu,Chaosheng Duan,Xiaohua Zeng,Hui Bi
keywords: power-split hybrid electric bus,dynamic coordinated control,mode transition,hierarchical control,
abstract: Mode switching can effectively improve the fuel economy of power-split hybrid buses. However， due to the direct coupling of the engine and motor into the power splitting mechanism， the dynamic characteristics of the motor and engine are inconsistent， and the oil pressure response of the clutch actuator is delayed， which can lead to violent fluctuation in engine speed and torque during mode switching. In order to solve this problem， a dynamic coordinated control of the mode switching process of hybrid buses based on hierarchical optimization is proposed. Firstly， the dynamic model of the power-split hybrid system is established by using the centralized mass method， and the dynamic coordinated control problem of the mode switching process is analyzed. Then， in order to reduce the torque fluctuation and impact in the process of mode switching， a dynamic coordinated control strategy based on hierarchical architecture is designed. In the upper layer， the improved wave superposition method and fuzzy sliding mode algorithm are used to calculate the torque instructions of the motor and clutch respectively. In the lower layer， a nonlinear three-step method is designed to control the oil pressure tracking of the clutch proportional pressure valve. The simulation results show that the controller can effectively suppress the speed and torque fluctuation of the transmission system， and has strong robustness to uncertain interference in the process of mode switching. In addition， the hardware-in-the-loop testing has shown that the controller is effective in real-time environment.

title: 基于系统化方法的电子机械制动器构型设计
title_en: Configuration Design of Electro-Mechanical Brakebased on A Systematic Approach
name: Hui Ma,Rongkang Luo,Zhihao Yu,Peibao Wu,Zhichao Hou
keywords: electro-mechanical brake,systematic design,configuration research,
abstract: The Electro-Mechanical Brake （EMB） is widely regarded as the development direction and research hotspot of brake-by-wire systems， due to its rapid response， high control precision and low energy consumption. To meet the needs of EMB design at the conceptual stage， this paper applies systematic design theory to carry out EMB configuration design， trying to establish a systematic method for EMB configuration generation and evaluation. Firstly， based on vehicle dynamics and the existing EMB concepts， the EMB function is divided into three key sub-functions， namely driving， decelerating and torque increasing， and motion conversion/force increasing. Secondly， schemes for sub-functions are then constructed and corresponding morphological matrices are developed， in terms of the component types and their arrangement in the wheel to achieve each sub-function. Subsequently， more than 330 configurations are then generated by enumerating the sub functional schemes based on the morphological matrix， of which 284 are new configurations. Finally， taking the passenger cars application as an example， the configurations are evaluated and selected by means of a preference matrix， and the configuration with the highest comprehensive score is figured out for subsequent research in future. The results show that the proposed method can systematically generate a large number of EMB configurations according to vehicle requirements and recommend solutions through evaluation， which is expected to significantly improve the adaptability and efficiency of EMB design.

title: 大角度姿态下基于体压分布的人体参数预测
title_en: Prediction of Human Parameters Based on Pressure Distribution in Large-Angle Posture
name: Zhifei Zhang,Qi Liu,Maochang Qiu,Chang Liu,Kanlun Tan,Le Bai
keywords: automotive seat,large-angle posture,pressure distribution,human parameter prediction,locally weighted regression,
abstract: To explore the relationship between body pressure distribution and human parameters under a large-angle posture in automotive seats， a study is conducted with 21 participants to perform body pressure distribution tests. Based on relevant anthropometric measurement standards， seven human characteristic parameters are selected as predictive targets： height， mass， lower leg length， thigh length， sitting height， thigh circumference， and maximum body width. Spearman correlation analysis is performed between these parameters and body pressure data to identify those body pressure metrics with strong correlation. A locally weighted regression （LWR） model is then used to fit the human parameter prediction model. The results show that the prediction models for the seven anthropometric parameters exhibite errors within 20%. Except for mass， the relative errors for the remaining six anthropometric parameters are all less than 10%， with the prediction for height demonstrating particularly good accuracy. Furthermore， to validate the applicability of this method， two different seating postures with varying seat back angles are selected as the validation group. The results show that the fitting accuracy for both postures is comparable to that of the initial test group， indicating good predictive performance.

title: 汽车智能照明垂向控制策略研究
title_en: Research on Vertical Control Strategy for Intelligent Automotive Lighting
name: Shaodong Zhou,Hui Zhang,Yingwen Zhang,Yan Li,Kai Jiang
keywords: intelligent automotive lighting,vehicle pitch angle observation,unknown input observer design,vertical lighting control,MPC,
abstract: The intelligent lighting system for automobiles can effectively enhance the perception ability of drivers or autonomous driving systems during nighttime driving by adjusting the illumination angle. However， for different nighttime driving scenarios on the road， the dynamic changes in the vehicle's pitch angle severely impacts the lighting performance of the vehicle. To enhance the adaptability of automotive lighting to complex nighttime road scenarios， in this paper a model for an intelligent automotive lighting system is established， considering the impact of changes in the traffic environment and the dynamic variation in the vehicle's pitch angle on vertical lighting. Additionally， to obtain the vehicle pitch angle information required for predictive control， in this paper a pitch angle observer and data-driven predictive model for the pitch angle based on the vehicle's vertical dynamics model is designed. Finally， co-simulation is carried out using MATLAB/Simulink and CarSim to experimentally verify the observation， prediction， and headlight control effect of the pitch angle. The simulation results show that the proposed vertical control strategy for intelligent automotive lighting can effectively enhance the vehicle's adaptability to nighttime road scenarios.

title: 基于燃料电池系统散热需求的风扇匹配研究
title_en: Study on Fan Matching for Fuel Cell System Thermal Management
name: Jie Tian,Zaoxiao Zhang
keywords: fuel cell,thermal management,electric fan,
abstract: With the promotion of global energy transformation and the national "dual carbon" strategy， fuel cell vehicles， as an important carrier of hydrogen energy utilization， are gradually becoming an important direction of the new energy for heavy commercial vehicles in medium and long-distance transportation scenarios， and the efficient matching degree of fuel cell thermal management system directly affects the performance and operational reliability of the vehicle. Based on the heat dissipation requirements of fuel cell systems and the performance of market-oriented electronic fans， in this paper two high-voltage large-diameter electronic fans and one low-voltage small-diameter electronic fan are matched and designed， and temperature control， power consumption， noise and other aspects are studied through CAE simulation and bench performance comparison tests. The results show that： （1） All three schemes can meet the heat dissipation requirements of the 132 kW fuel cell system， and the theoretical heat dissipation capacity of the system is Scheme 3>Scheme 2>Scheme 1； （2） Under the same heat dissipation power requirement， the power consumption of Scheme 1 is only 24.6% of that of Scheme 2 （the output power of the fuel cell is 110 kW）， and at the same measurement point， the minimum difference in fan noise between Scheme 2 and Scheme 1 is 9 dB（A）， and the maximum is 17 dB（A）. This research provides a theoretical basis and practical reference for the design and optimization of the thermal management system of the subsequent fuel cell system.

title: 基于多权重声誉机制与联邦学习的电动汽车IPMSM故障诊断研究
title_en: Research on Fault Diagnosis of Electric Vehicle IPMSM Based on Multi-Weight Reputation Mechanism and Federated Learning
name: Jiaheng Li,Qinmu Wu,Tao Hong,Liu Yang,Boxue Xu
keywords: motor fault diagnosis,reputation mechanism,federated learning,interior permanent magnet synchronous motor,attack defense,internet of vehicles,
abstract: In the context of contemporary big data and artificial intelligence， with the increasing level of intelligence in electric vehicles， the demand for motor fault diagnosis has grown significantly， particularly in ensuring the safety and reliability of motor operation. This study focuses on the diagnosis of rotor demagnetization and eccentricity faults in Interior Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors （IPMSM）. By employing federated learning， distributed data training and privacy protection is realized， thus avoiding centralized data storage and processing while safeguarding data privacy. Additionally， a multi-weight reputation mechanism based on Exponential Moving Average （EMA） dynamic updates and diversity factors is designed， which comprehensively considers multiple factors， including time decay， historical stability， and collaborative feature contribution， to dynamically assess the reliability of participating nodes. As a result， it enhances defense against malicious attacks while reducing the likelihood of incorrectly excluding honest nodes， thereby improving model-training performance. The experimental results demonstrate that the method exhibits excellent robustness and security across various malicious attack scenarios， effectively eliminating malicious nodes while avoiding inadvertent deletion of honest nodes. Compared to traditional reputation mechanisms， the proposed method improves diagnostic accuracy by 8.937%、5.146%， 9.868%， and 5.675% under four different attack scenarios.

title: 智能汽车信息物理系统研究进展
title_en: Research Progress on Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems
name: Dihua Sun,Shenglong Jiang,Bolin Gao,Min Zhao,Jingdong Lin,Yayue Xiao,Hao Liang,Keqiang Li
keywords: cyber-physical systems,intelligent vehicles,model-based systems engineering,system-of-systems,hierarchical decoupling,cross-domain collaboration,
abstract: Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical System （IVCPS） is a complex system integrating heterogeneous cyber-physical agents， which reflects the development trends and key technological features of vehicle intelligence and connectivity. This paper investigates the definition， connotation， system characteristics， and development pathways of IVCPS， and reviews the research progress on its architecture， modeling methods， design approaches， and verification and validation techniques. A case study of intelligent bus application is also presented. Finally， the main challenges and future trends of IVCPS in collaborative mechanism， model alignment， cyber-physical synchronization， testing and validation， and information security are summarized， which can provide a reference for related research and engineering practice.

title: 智能汽车赛博物理系统领域特定建模语言配置方法研究
title_en: Research on Configuration Methods for Domain-Specific Modeling Languages in Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems
name: Jing Zhao,Yong Wang,Yayue Xiao
keywords: cyber-physical systems of intelligent vehicles,SysML,configuration of domain-specific modeling language,verification of domain modeling language,
abstract: To address the challenges in the design of Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical System （IVCPS）， such as broad interdisciplinary technical scope， cross-phase collaboration difficulties， ambiguous modeling language definition， and inconsistent granularity description， in this study a unified modeling approach based on the Profile extension mechanism and model composition techniques is proposed. By establishing a domain-specific modeling language （DSML） tailored to IVCPS architecture design phases， a modeling framework is constructed， incorporating a stereotype system， standardized view templates， and phased project templates. This framework enables end-to-end mapping and encapsulation of the entire design process， spanning business analysis， functional analysis， logical architecture definition， and physical architecture configuration. Innovatively， the research develops core repositories including a domain-specific element repository， atomic component repository， and cyber component repository. An integrated interaction approach combining page navigation and case-driven guidance is adopted to support standardized modeling activities across phases. Through installation/uninstallation verification and modeling validation， the proposed IVCPS domain-specific modeling language is demonstrated to be executable on the CatiaMagic software platform. The results confirm the achievement of unified and efficient IVCPS modeling objectives， effectively supporting cross-phase unified modeling effort for IVCPS.

title: 智能汽车信息物理系统知识图谱模块化设计
title_en: Modular Design of Knowledge Graph for Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems
name: Peiyu Li,Honghui Dong,Heshu Yun,Qi Zhang,Chong Shang,Hongfeng Yin,Yusong Lin
keywords: intelligent vehicle cyber-physical systems （IVCPS）,knowledge graph （KG）,modular design,module combination,
abstract: For the current problem that there is no complete theoretical system and implementation method for cross-domain module design of the intelligent vehicle cyber-physical system （IVCPS） knowledge graph， this paper achieves the construction and application of a cross-domain module design system for the IVCPS knowledge graph through key technologies such as knowledge representation， top-down decomposition of complex systems， and demand-driven bottom-up dynamic module integration. By implementing standardized interface and a modular design that combines layering and classification， a loosely coupled integration between modules is realized， supporting pluggable hardware modules， iterative software modules， and sustainable evolution of system modules. This forms an extensible and integrated system framework that effectively supports a new development paradigm of functional customization and dynamic composition for IVCPS.

title: 车路协同系统中车载真值系统测试方法研究
title_en: Research on Testing Methods for Vehicle-Mounted Ground Truth Systems in Vehicle-Infrastructure Cooperative Systems
name: Deli Wang,Lianfu Li,Wei Zhang,Xin Jiang
keywords: vehicle-infrastructure cooperation （VIC）,onboard ground truth system,perception fusion,velocity,heading angle,planar position,multidimensional data,
abstract: For the problem of quantifying the accuracy evaluation of onboard ground truth systems and the perceived targets in vehicle-infrastructure cooperative systems， in this study based on the investigation of the mainstream components of current vehicle-infrastructure cooperative systems， for diverse sensor-collected multimodal data， a multidimensional data metrological traceability testing method is proposed. Experimental tests are conducted at the GNSS receiver-testing field of the National Institute of Metrology （NIM）， China. The results show that the onboard ground truth system exhibits significant errors in speed and planar position during vehicle acceleration， deceleration， and turning maneuvers， suggesting that the system's algorithms still require improvement and optimization. In near-uniform linear motion， the average speed error is 0.02 m/s， the average heading angle error is 0.07°， and the average planar position error is 0.06 m—all three metrics meet the technical requirements specified in the test protocol. Finally， the system's perception tests on pedestrians， non-motorized vehicles， and motor vehicles （measuring speed， heading angle， and planar position） validate the accuracy of the multidimensional data fusion algorithm and target modeling. By classifying and extracting multidimensional data， all measurements can be traced back to national standards or reference benchmarks， providing valuable insights for evaluating data accuracy in vehicle-infrastructure cooperative systems.

title: 智能汽车信息物理系统的零信任安全通信
title_en: Zero-Trust Secure Communication for Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems
name: Wenyan Yan,Guoqi Xie,Shuang Huang,Xinzhong Liu,Wei Xu,Jianmei Lei
keywords: intelligent vehicle cyber-physical system,zero trust,information security,authentication and authorization,
abstract: The rapid development of intelligent vehicle cyber-physical systems （CPS） is driving the evolution of vehicles from a distributed architecture to a domain-centralized architecture. However， the widespread adoption of vehicle-to-everything （V2X） communication has significantly increased the information security risks of intelligent vehicle communication networks， such as spoofed terminal access， man-in-the-middle attacks， and malicious message injection. To address these threats， in this paper a zero-trust security communication framework is proposed for intelligent vehicle CPS. The framework uses a central gateway or a cloud-based policy decision point （PDP）， thereby enforcing identity authentication and communication authorization to ensure message authenticity， confidentiality， integrity， and availability， while also incorporating a message identification feature that permits only designated nodes to process authorized messages. An intelligent vehicle CPS physical platform is constructed based on NXP automotive-grade switch chip SJA1105 （as the central gateway） and NXP automotive grade processor S32K148 176LQFP processor as the domain controller. After deploying the framework on this prototype， the security of the framework is verified using ProVerif. The evaluation results based on prototype platform and V2X scenarios show that the proposed framework outperforms existing automotive security frameworks in both computational and communication efficiency. To validate the generality and extensibility of the proposed framework， this paper further applies the zero-trust secure communication framework to the over-the-air （OTA） update scenario， constructing a secure update paradigm based on continuous verification and dynamic authorization.

title: 智能汽车信息物理系统下信号交叉口排队消散时间预测
title_en: Prediction of Queue Dissipation Time at Signalized Intersections Under Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems
name: Guanzhong Li,Wei Zhong,Shuyan Li,Bolin Gao
keywords: cyber-physical systems,queue dissipation time,stacking model,queue pattern recognition,
abstract: The efficiency of green-wave coordination is highly dependent on the accurate prediction of queue dissipation time at signalized intersections， which， however， exhibits strong dynamic complexity and pattern heterogeneity. Inaccurate prediction may cause vehicles to reach the end of the queue prematurely， resulting in forced deceleration or stoppage， thereby reducing traffic efficiency and increasing energy consumption. Intelligent Vehicle Cyber-Physical Systems （IVCPS） provide multi-source traffic perception and real-time computational capabilities， creating favorable conditions for developing high-precision predictive models in the information space. To address the heterogeneity of queue dissipation processes and the limitation of prediction accuracy， in this study a queue dissipation time prediction model that integrates pattern recognition and stacking ensemble learning is proposed， termed PRISM （Pattern Recognition and Integrated Stacking Model）， which is deployed in the foundational layer of the IVCPS information space. PRISM firstly identifies four typical queue dissipation patterns and determines the optimal parameter configuration for each， thereby decomposing the complex global prediction task into multiple homogeneous local sub-tasks. On this basis， a two-layer stacking ensemble model composed of heterogeneous base learners such as XGBoost is constructed to fully exploit the complementary strengths of different learners across various queue patterns. The experiments based on real traffic data collected from Tianjin show that the proposed model achieves a mean absolute percentage error （MAPE） of 7.82%， a mean absolute error （MAE） of 1.00 s， and an average single-sample prediction time of 3.6 ms. The results indicate that PRISM can effectively leverage the multi-source perception and computational advantages of IVCPS， providing reliable predictive support for dynamic signal timing and green-wave speed planning.

title: 基于云端自进化学习的车辆轨迹预测方法
title_en: Vehicle Trajectory Prediction Method Using Cloud-Based Self-Evolving Learning
name: Zhaozheng Hu,Yuanhai Wang,Yanjun Huang,Jianan Zhang,Feng Feng,Jie Meng
keywords: trajectory prediction,self-evolutionary learning,distributed cloud,closed-loop feedback,
abstract: Trajectory prediction plays a critical role in ensuring safety and decision-making efficiency in autonomous driving systems. However， existing approaches generally lack continuous learning and self-evolution capabilities， making it difficult to achieve sustained performance improvement. To address this issue， in this paper an optimized vehicle trajectory prediction method based on cloud-enabled self-evolving learning is proposed， incorporating a closed-loop feedback mechanism and adaptive learning strategies to enhance model performance and generalization. Firstly， a self-evolving trajectory prediction optimization framework supported by the cloud is constructed. It enables real-time data collection and selection on the vehicle side， distributed cloud-based automated training and validation， and automatic model deployment， thereby achieving efficient and continuous model optimization through multiple rounds of closed-loop feedback. Secondly， a multi-vehicle collaborative data augmentation mechanism is designed， combining virtual and real scenarios for multi-modal data collection. A teacher-student framework is introduced to filter negative samples on the vehicle side， enhancing the representativeness of the training data. Finally， a distributed cloud-based trajectory prediction model optimization approach is proposed. A distributed cloud platform is built where the data cloud integrates heterogeneous data from multiple vehicles， the training cloud and validation cloud perform large-scale model training and iterative validation respectively， and rapid model iteration and adaptive deployment are achieved through a vehicle-cloud collaboration mechanism. The experimental results show that after multiple rounds of self-evolutionary learning， the model performance continuously improves. The relative improvement rate of the average displacement error and the final displacement error of vehicle trajectory prediction reaches 66.1% and 57.1%， respectively. This method significantly enhances the accuracy of trajectory prediction， demonstrating strong adaptability and continuous optimization capabilities.

title: 基于量子密钥的车联网数据批量共享方案
title_en: Quantum Key-Based Batch Data Sharing Scheme for Internet of Vehicles
name: Ze Yang,Qin Shi,Teng Cheng,Xiyu Fang,Ziang Cao,Qiang Luo
keywords: internet of vehicle,batch sharing,quantum key,batch authentication,
abstract: Data leakage of the Internet of Vehicles （IoV） will harm the interests of vehicle owners and even compromise the safety of driving vehicles. To address the problem， in this paper a secure data sharing scheme for IoV based on quantum key is proposed. In this scheme， privacy-enhanced key authorization distribution is firstly carried out through a vehicle end quantum random number generator and pre-set quantum keys so that unauthorized third parties cannot access the quantum keys. Secondly， batch authentication and access control through quantum keys and Lagrange interpolation algorithms are realized. Security proofs and performance comparison show that the proposed scheme can withstand internal privilege attacks with lower computational and communication overheads. The simulation results and test verification show that the proposed scheme has better communication performance and application feasibility， realizing efficient and security data sharing.

title: 无信号灯控制交叉路口车-车交互场景基元库构建
title_en: Construction of a Scene Primitive Library for Vehicle-to-Vehicle Interaction at Unsignalized Intersections
name: Lin Hu,Xudong Chen,Xinghua Wang,Feifan Yang
keywords: unsignalized intersection,vehicle-to-vehicle interaction,nonparametric Bayesian,scene primitive library,
abstract: Virtual testing is an efficient， cost-effective， and controllable way to assess the safety and performance of self-driving systems. However， most current virtual test scenarios lack key details such as vehicle speed and heading during interaction， making the scenarios less realistic and comprehensive， which in turn reduces test reliability. Correctly identifying and representing the features of vehicle interaction is crucial to improving the realism of test scenarios. In this study， a library of basic vehicle-vehicle interaction scene elements for unsignalized intersections is built using the inD dataset. Firstly， a nonparametric Bayesian model is used to segment scene elements in two-vehicle interaction sequences. The multidimensional continuous variables are then discretized into distinct semantic categories. Next， a distance matrix is constructed using one-hot encoding and Hamming distance， followed by clustering analysis with the K-Medoids algorithm， identifying 25 types of two-vehicle interaction scene primitives with different motion characteristics and systematically revealing the diversity of real-world traffic interaction. The scene primitive library can help create more realistic and diverse virtual test scenarios for autonomous vehicles.

title: 语义驱动的4D雷达与相机融合目标检测
title_en: Semantic-Driven 4D Radar and Camera Fusion Object Detection
name: Lianqing Zheng,Wenjin Ai,Zhixiong Ma,Hongze Ren,Shouyi Lu,Rui Liu,Shengyu Yan,Xichan Zhu,Jie Bai
keywords: autonomous driving,multimodal fusion,3D object detection,4D millimeter-wave radar,vision-language model,
abstract: Robust 3D object detection via camera-4D radar fusion is crucial for autonomous driving safety. However， existing fusion methods focus on low-level geometric-pixel alignment while neglecting scene-level semantics， resulting in suboptimal performance. Therefore， in this paper， RCT-Net， the first vision-language model enhanced 4D radar-camera fusion framework for 3D detection， is proposed. Firstly， prompts are used to guide the VLM to generate scene-level textual descriptions containing objects of interest， which are then encoded into semantic features via a text encoder. Next， the TBFusion （Text-BEV Fusion） module is designed， which deeply integrates scene semantic features into Bird's-Eye-View （BEV） space through a novel cross-modal attention mechanism. This module simultaneously guides image feature perspective transformation via prior knowledge and semantically enhances multi-modal BEV features during fusion. Finally， a 3D detection head decodes the refined features to predict object attributes. The experiments on TJ4DRadSet and View-of-Delft datasets show excellent performance of the RCT-Net， （41.34% and 57.02% 3D mAP）， demonstrating the framework's effectiveness and progressiveness.

title: 考虑多车博弈的自动驾驶耦合预测规划方法
title_en: Autonomous Driving Coupled Prediction and Planning Method Considering Multi-Vehicle Game Interaction
name: Mengqi Hou,Yingfeng Cai,Long Chen,Hai Wang,Yubo Lian,Qingchao Liu,Ze Liu
keywords: autonomous vehicles,complex network cognition,interactive game prediction,differential game planning,
abstract: The driving environment for autonomous vehicles is a complex dynamic system. Accurately predicting the motion states of other traffic participants is a crucial prerequisite for safely planning the ego vehicle's trajectory. Current mainstream methods all adopt a "predict first， then plan" framework， which leads to insufficient handling of interactive scenarios. In this paper a coupled prediction-planning framework is proposed that combines differential game planning and hierarchical game-theoretic prediction， guided by complex network risk cognition for integrated learning. Complex network theory is used to model dynamic interaction between vehicles to derive a risk cognition function for vehicle interaction. A Transformer-based complex network encoder and an interaction decoder that combines Transformer with hierarchical game theory are constructed to iteratively refine the predicted future trajectories of surrounding cognitive-domain agents. The planning's utility function co-iterates with predicted trajectories and preliminary vehicle planning to achieve coupled prediction-planning optimization. Validation experiments on the nuPlan dataset show the proposed method significantly improves various metrics in both open-loop and closed-loop tests， including comfort and speed， outperforming both learning-based and rule-based approaches.

title: 一种驾驶目标动态调整的人机博弈共驾方法
title_en: A Human-Machine Game Co-Driving Method for Dynamic Adjustment of Driving Goals
name: Xianbin Wang,Wenlong Bao,Yanqing Xu,Qiuyuan Han,Yingzhe Zhang
keywords: human-machine co-driving,non-cooperative game,driving goal weight matrix,human-machine control weight,path tracking and stability control,
abstract: In order to address the driving goal conflict that arises during the human-machine cooperative path tracking control of intelligent vehicles and to achieve dynamic adjustment of the driving goal of the driver and auxiliary system， a method of dynamic adjustment of the driving goal of human-machine system based on non-cooperative Nash game theory is proposed. Firstly， the vehicle single-track dynamics model is employed to establish a human-machine co-driving system model where the driver and the AFS （Active Front Steering） and ARS （Active Rear Steering） systems are in the same loop together. The driver and the AFS systems are assigned to path tracking accuracy， and the ARS system is assigned to lateral stability as their respective driving goals. Subsequently， the system prediction model is formulated， and the cost functions of the three players are obtained. Subsequently， within the paradigm of non-cooperative gameplay， a methodology for adjusting the human-machine control weight update strategy， contingent on the driving objective weight matrix update， is proposed. This approach culminates in the resolution of the Nash equilibrium solution within the context of the three-player game. Finally， the coordination ability of the game co-driving method is verified by joint simulation tests in terms of path tracking accuracy and lateral stability performance under severe working conditions.

title: 基于多数据流并行传输的C-V2X资源调度协议的优化及性能分析
title_en: Optimization and Performance Analysis of C-V2X Resource Scheduling Protocol Based on Parallel Multi-Data Streams Transmission
name: Zufang Dou,Yalong Wang,Leijiao Ge,Qiaoli Yang,Taiguo Li
keywords: C-V2X,Mode 4,sensing based semi-persistent scheduling （S-SPS） algorithm,multi-priority data streams,dscrete-time Markov chain （DTMC）,
abstract: Internet of Vehicles communication technology effectively enhances the Quality of Service （QoS） by supporting parallel data streams. However， the existing C-V2X technology fails to fully consider the differences in the characteristics of multiple data streams during the transmission process， resulting in unbalanced scheduling and serious waste of communication resources. Therefore， in this paper an S-SPS resource scheduling protocol based on multi-stream parallel transmission is proposed， which optimizes the window parameters of resource Reselection Counter （RC） according to the generation frequency and service requirements of various data streams， aiming at enhancing the system resource utilization and reducing the collision probability. Secondly， a Discrete-Time Markov Chain （DTMC） model is established for the proposed protocol， and the system performance indexes such as average delay， collision probability and average channel utilization are obtained. Then the balance between system latency and utilization rate is achieved by establishing a multi-objective model to optimize the RC window parameters. Finally， the proposed protocol is analyzed and verified by numerical simulation. The simulation results show that compared with existing protocols， the proposed protocol can achieve lower average delay， higher channel utilization and throughput in both single-stream and multi-stream transmission.

title: 区域集中式架构下智能车辆通信拓扑设计
title_en: Design of Communication Topology for Intelligent Vehicles Under Zonal Centralized Architecture
name: Manjiang Hu,Shoulin Wen,Tianchuang Meng,Zeyu Yang,Xianfeng Wang,Hui Song
keywords: intelligent vehicle,zonal centralized architecture,communication topology,lightweight and low-cost,intelligent design,Mean Shift,APO,
abstract: The zonal centralized architecture has significant advantages in lightweight and low-latency communication compared to distributed architecture， yet its lightweight and low-cost communication topology design still faces problems， including the lack of systematic optimization schemes， reliance on manual settings for region quantity or location， and neglect of communication harness characteristics. To address these， in this paper an intelligent design method for lightweight and low-cost communication topology based on zonal centralized architecture is proposed. The method decouples the topology design problem into two subproblems： underlying component-to-gateway connection generation and gateway-to-computing platform layout optimization. Firstly， the Mean Shift clustering algorithm is employed to automatically generate topology connection between sensors， actuators， ECUs， and zonal gateways. Then， an optimization model incorporating the characteristics of communication harnesses is developed， and the Arctic Puffin Optimization algorithm is applied to iteratively optimize the layout positions of zonal gateways and computing platforms.
